title: Junior/Mid-Level Podcast Editor
description:
We're looking for a motivated Junior/Mid-Level Podcast Editor to join our team. Your primary focus will be cleaning up and editing podcast episodes while upskilling in YouTube and advanced editing by learning directly from our experienced professionals.



We need someone with fundamental to decent skills in animating text, rotobrushing, audio balancing, and SFX work. While we provide mentorship, our goal is for you to become a self-sufficient editor who can eventually handle complex projects with minimal hand-holding. If you have the basics down and want to learn how to produce world-class content, this is the place for you.



Key Responsibilities:



Clean, balance, and edit raw podcast audio and video into polished, high-quality episodes. Minimum of 1 edit a week.

Execute rigorous quality control, ensuring there are absolutely no syncing issues, dead air, or typos in on-screen text.

Design and implement animated intros, text overlays, and basic SFX to enhance the listener and viewer experience.

Actively learn from senior editors to master advanced VFX and YouTube-specific storytelling techniques.

Take ownership of the podcast pipeline to achieve full self-sufficiency in the production process.



Requirements:



Fundamental and decent skill level in Adobe Premiere Pro and After Effects.

Extreme attention to detail, you hate seeing a single typo or a frame out of sync.

A portfolio demonstrating your ability to handle clean audio balancing and basic motion graphics.

A "student of the game" mentality: you want to learn quickly and become an independent powerhouse.

Strong communication skills and a commitment to feedback, iteration, and speed.

Self-motivated, organized, and able to meet weekly deadlines without sacrificing quality.

Color grading, fundamental sound design, and audio mixing skills.



Our Standard — Reference Videos:



These are the benchmarks for the work. Watch them before applying so you know the level we're editing at:











Bonus Points For:



Experience editing educational or personal brand content for high-performing entrepreneurs.

A knack for building out efficient editing pipelines and managing timelines in Frame.io & ClickUp or similar.



Rate: $100–150 per video (based on skill & speed, let us know your rate range when applying)



If you can make our content punch harder, look sharper, and feel world-class… we want you.



Apply with a link to your portfolio.

title: TikTok & Short-Form Video Editor – White & Co
description:
TIKTOK & SHORT-FORM VIDEO EDITOR

White & Co | Australian Women's Fashion Brand



Remote – Philippines preferred

Part-time: 15–20 hours per week

US$8–12/hour depending on experience



White & Co is a successful Australian women's fashion brand looking for a talented TikTok & Short-Form Video Editor to join our team.



We are looking for someone who doesn't just know how to edit video. We want someone who understands TikTok.



Someone who knows what makes people stop scrolling, understands hooks, pacing, captions, trends and storytelling – and can turn simple iPhone footage into content people actually want to watch.



THE ROLE



Our founder will regularly film raw iPhone footage including:

• Fashion and styling content

• New products

• Behind-the-scenes footage

• Store visits

• Design and buying

• Day-in-the-life content

• Founder commentary

• Try-ons

• Travel/fashion content

• Team and business content



Your job is to take that raw footage and turn it into engaging TikToks and Instagram Reels.



YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES



• Edit approximately 8–12 short-form videos per week

• Create strong hooks in the first 1–3 seconds

• Remove pauses and unnecessary footage

• Create engaging pacing

• Add captions and on-screen text

• Select appropriate music and sounds

• Use relevant TikTok trends where appropriate

• Add B-roll where useful

• Create clean, modern fashion-focused edits

• Create cover images

• Export videos ready for TikTok and Instagram

• Make revisions based on feedback

• Organise footage and finished videos in Google Drive

• Eventually contribute ideas for new content

• Monitor content performance and suggest improvements



IMPORTANT



We are NOT looking for someone who simply cuts videos together.



We want someone who understands:

Hooks + retention + storytelling + trends + fashion + social media.



You should be able to look at raw footage and identify the most interesting moment.



REQUIRED



• Minimum 2 years' experience editing short-form video

• Strong TikTok and Instagram Reels knowledge

• Excellent CapCut skills

• Excellent English

• Strong understanding of hooks and retention

• Good sense of fashion and aesthetics

• Strong attention to detail

• Reliable and responsive

• Able to work independently

• Stable internet connection



PREFERRED



Experience working with:

• Women's fashion

• E-commerce

• Fashion brands

• Lifestyle brands

• Beauty brands

• Personal brands/founders



Experience with Premiere Pro, Canva, OpusClip or other AI video tools is a bonus.



HOURS



15–20 hours per week initially.



PAY



US$8–12/hour depending on experience and portfolio.



APPLICATION



Please send:

1. Your name

2. Your location/time zone

3. Your CV

4. Your portfolio

5. 5–10 examples of TikTok/Reels you have edited

6. Your experience with fashion/e-commerce brands, if any

7. Your hourly rate

8. Your availability

9. The editing software you use

10. Answer: What makes someone stop scrolling on TikTok in the first 3 seconds?

11. Include the word WHITE at the beginning of your application.



Shortlisted applicants will complete a paid editing trial using real White & Co footage.

title: # AI App Builder / No-Code Developer + Cinematic AI Video Creator
description:
We are looking for a skilled **AI App Builder / No-Code Developer with strong AI cinematic video creation experience** to help develop a premium membership, education, and community web application.



This is NOT a basic website project.



We need someone who can combine **functional app development with high-end cinematic AI content creation**.



The right candidate should be comfortable using AI-assisted development tools to build a real full-stack application AND creating visually impressive, cinematic AI videos that can be incorporated throughout the platform.



## WHAT YOU WILL HELP BUILD



The initial project is a premium online membership, education, and community platform.



The application will include:



### Public Website



* Homepage

* Program information

* Curriculum/program overview

* Membership

* Login / Sign Up

* Stripe checkout



### Member Platform



Members should be able to:



* Create and manage accounts

* Complete onboarding

* Access a personalized dashboard

* Access educational modules/stages

* Open lessons

* Watch training videos

* Experience cinematic introductions and transitions

* Download resources

* Complete assignments/missions

* Track progress

* See locked/unlocked content

* Resume where they previously stopped

* Search a resource library

* View announcements

* Participate in a community

* Manage their profile and membership



### Admin Dashboard



Administrators must be able to:



* Create/edit/reorder modules

* Create/edit lessons

* Upload and replace videos

* Upload downloadable resources

* Upload cinematic video content

* Publish/unpublish content

* Manage members

* Manage membership plans

* Create announcements

* View member progress

* View basic platform activity



## CINEMATIC AI VIDEO EXPERIENCE — IMPORTANT



This is a major part of the position.



We are NOT looking for someone who only knows how to generate basic AI videos from simple prompts.



We want someone who understands how to create **premium, cinematic, story-driven AI video experiences**.



You should understand concepts such as:



* Cinematic storytelling

* Shot composition

* Camera angles

* Camera movement

* Lighting

* Scene continuity

* Character consistency

* Image-to-video workflows

* Storyboarding

* Establishing shots

* Close-ups

* Tracking shots

* Dolly shots

* Crane shots

* Orbit shots

* Slow motion

* Depth of field

* Cinematic transitions

* Color grading/look development

* Visual pacing

* Music-driven editing

* Creating multiple shots that feel like one cohesive sequence



The goal is NOT to make generic talking-head AI videos.



We want the platform to incorporate experiences that feel more like:



**Movie Trailers • Premium Commercials • Music Videos • Streaming-Series Intros • Cinematic Brand Films**



You should know how to take an idea or written concept and turn it into a **multi-shot cinematic sequence**, not simply generate one random AI clip.



### AI VIDEO TOOLS



Experience with tools such as the following is highly desirable:



* Higgsfield

* Kling

* Google Veo

* Runway

* Sora

* Seedance

* Midjourney or other AI image-generation tools

* AI video editing/upscaling tools

* Other professional generative video workflows



You do not have to use every tool listed above.



However, you MUST be able to demonstrate that you understand cinematic AI video creation.



## AI VIDEO INTEGRATION



We are also interested in candidates who understand how AI video generation can eventually be incorporated directly into a web application.



Experience with any of the following is a major advantage:



* AI video APIs

* Image generation APIs

* Image-to-video APIs

* Prompt-generation systems

* Character consistency workflows

* Video generation pipelines

* API-based generation status/progress

* Cloud video storage

* Generated media libraries



The selected candidate may eventually help create an experience where users can generate cinematic content from within the application.



## TECHNICAL SKILLS



Experience with some or all of the following is preferred:



* v0 / Vercel

* Supabase

* Stripe

* React

* Next.js

* GitHub

* AI-assisted development

* Database design

* Authentication

* Role-based permissions

* API integrations

* Responsive web applications

* Membership platforms

* Learning management systems

* Community platforms



## BACKEND EXPERIENCE



You should understand how to implement:



* User authentication

* Sign up / login / logout

*
 verification

* Forgot/reset password

* User profiles

* Database tables and relationships

* Member vs. administrator permissions

* Paid membership access

* Stripe subscriptions

* Subscription status

* Product entitlements

* Course progress

* File storage

* Secure access policies

* Persistent user data



Experience with **Supabase and Row Level Security (RLS)** is highly desirable.



## PHASE ONE PRIORITY



The core application journey must actually work:



Visitor ? Membership ? Payment ? Account Creation ? Onboarding ? Member Dashboard ? Module ? Lesson ? Assignment ? Progress Saved ? Logout ? Return ? Resume Progress



We do NOT want fake functionality, placeholder buttons that appear functional, or an application that only looks good in screenshots.



## DESIGN EXPECTATIONS



We want a premium, modern and cinematic digital experience.



Think:



**Premium Streaming Platform × Online Learning Platform × Creator Community × Cinematic Studio**



The platform should feel immersive and visually exciting rather than like a generic online course website.



It must work properly on:



* Desktop

* Laptop

* Tablet

* iPhone

* Android



## FUTURE SCALABILITY



Although Phase One focuses on the membership and educational platform, the architecture must support additional digital products and AI capabilities in the future.



The long-term architecture should support:



**ONE ACCOUNT. ONE CUSTOMER IDENTITY. MULTIPLE PRODUCT ENTITLEMENTS.**



Future products are NOT part of the initial build.



## IDEAL CANDIDATE



You are a strong candidate if you can do BOTH:



**1. BUILD**



Create functional applications using AI development tools, databases, APIs, authentication, payments, and modern web technologies.



**2. CREATE**



Produce high-quality cinematic AI video content and understand how generative image/video technology can become part of the application experience.



We are particularly interested in someone who is creative AND technical.



## WHEN APPLYING



Please provide:



1. Links/screenshots/videos of applications you personally built.

2. Links to AI-generated cinematic videos you personally created.

3. Which AI app-building tools you use.

4. Which AI video tools you use.

5. Your experience with Higgsfield or similar platforms.

6. Your experience with Supabase.

7. Your experience with Stripe subscriptions.

8. Any LMS, membership, SaaS, community, or admin dashboard projects you have built.

9. Your experience integrating APIs.

10. Your hourly rate.

11. Your weekly availability.



## REQUIRED APP DEVELOPMENT QUESTION



Please answer:



**A customer pays through Stripe and should immediately receive access to protected member content. Briefly explain how you would connect the payment, user account, database, and access permissions.**



## REQUIRED CINEMATIC VIDEO QUESTION



Please answer:



**If you were asked to create a 30-second cinematic introduction consisting of 6–8 connected shots, explain the tools and workflow you would use to maintain visual quality, character consistency, scene continuity, camera movement, and a professional cinematic look.**



Please include a link to at least one example of cinematic AI video work you personally created.



## PAID TEST



Final candidates may be asked to complete a small paid test.



The test may include BOTH:



**App Development Test**



User Login ? Member Dashboard ? Course Module ? Lesson ? Save User Progress



AND



**Cinematic Test**



Create a short multi-shot cinematic sequence from a creative brief provided by us.



We will evaluate:



* Functionality

* Visual quality

* Cinematic quality

* Storytelling

* Prompting ability

* Camera movement

* Scene/character consistency

* Mobile responsiveness

* Database structure

* Security

* Technical organization

* Troubleshooting

* Communication

* Speed and efficiency



Additional information about the company, brand, content, and complete platform vision will only be shared with selected candidates.

title: Medical Coder (Psychiatry & Behavioral Health)
description:
We are seeking an experienced Medical Coder specializing in psychiatry and behavioral health to join our team. You will be responsible for reviewing psychiatric clinical documentation, ensuring accurate code assignment, and optimizing billing workflows.



Key Responsibilities:



Review clinical notes, psychiatric evaluations, and therapy session documentation for accuracy.



Assign accurate ICD-10-CM codes, CPT codes (e.g., diagnostic evaluations, psychotherapy, medication management), and HCPCS modifiers.



Ensure compliance with CMS guidelines, HIPAA, and commercial payer requirements.



Identify and resolve coding discrepancies, claim denials, or documentation gaps alongside clinical staff.



Qualifications:



Certified Professional Coder (CPC) or Certified Coding Specialist (CCS) designation required.



Minimum 2 years of dedicated medical coding experience in psychiatry, mental health, or behavioral healthcare.



Proficiency in CPT coding for psychiatric diagnostic procedures, psychotherapy time-based add-on codes, and interactive complexity.



Strong knowledge of medical terminology, psychiatric conditions, and payer billing guidelines.

title: Shopify Store redesign and development
description:
Shopify Developer & Store Redesign Specialist



We are looking for an experienced Shopify Developer / Designer to help completely redesign and improve our existing Shopify store.



We need someone who is highly confident working within Shopify and can handle both the design and development side of the website.



What we need



You must be able to:



Redesign and improve the overall look and feel of our Shopify store



Work confidently within Shopify themes and theme customisation



Edit Shopify theme code including Liquid, HTML, CSS and JavaScript



Add, remove or modify sections and functionality throughout the website



Create custom sections and features where required



Replicate or recreate design elements and functionality we like from other websites and adapt them to suit our own store



Improve homepage, collection pages, product pages, menus and navigation



Ensure the website looks professional and works seamlessly across desktop and mobile



Improve site usability and customer experience



Make changes without unnecessarily affecting existing products, orders or Shopify data



Troubleshoot and fix Shopify theme or coding issues



Recommend improvements where you see opportunities



What we are looking for



We need someone who:



Has strong previous experience with Shopify store redesigns



Understands Shopify extremely well — not just basic drag-and-drop editing



Has strong Shopify coding experience



Has excellent attention to detail



Can follow visual references closely



Understands modern eCommerce design and conversion-focused layouts



Can work independently without needing constant direction



Communicates clearly and provides regular updates



Works quickly and efficiently



Can implement changes in a fast and timely manner



Is responsive and available when changes or revisions are required



Speed is very important to us. We do not want a project that takes weeks to complete simple changes. We are looking for someone experienced who can understand what is required, execute quickly and keep the project moving.

 videos

title: Operations & Growth Manager
description:
Operations & Growth Manager Location: Remote | Type: Full-time | Reports to: Owner



About Us????

We're a family-owned craft kit brand primarily selling on Amazon US (FBA) across 76 SKUs in categories like cross stitch, embroidery, latch hook, fuse beads, and licensed kits. We run a lean, highly automated operation — Claude AI handles a large portion of daily intelligence, PPC analysis, and reporting. You'll be working with these tools, not around them.



Role Overview????

We're looking for a sharp, AI-fluent Operations & Growth Manager to own the full execution layer of our business — from inventory and fulfillment to PPC, promotions, and product launches. This is a high-ownership role for someone who thinks in systems, moves fast, and knows how to use AI tools to punch above their weight.



Responsibilities????

PPC & Advertising - Manage Amazon Sponsored Products campaigns across 17+ portfolios (US + Canada) - Manage Walmart Advertising campaigns - Review AI-generated bid recommendations, search term harvests, and negative keyword suggestions — approve, adjust, and execute - Monitor daily PPC health dashboards; investigate anomalies and act on signals - Maintain healthy TACoS targets per portfolio stage (launch, growth, harvest)



Deals, Coupons & Promotions - Set up and manage Amazon coupons, Lightning Deals, and Prime Exclusive Discounts - Coordinate Walmart promotional pricing and deal submissions - Track deal performance and competitive pricing; adjust strategy based on results - Manage promotional calendar around key seasons (Prime Day, Q4, back-to-school)



Product Launches - Execute end-to-end Amazon launches: listing go-live, PPC campaign setup, Vine enrollment, rank tracking - Coordinate launch phases — honeymoon period management, spend ramp-up, keyword rank milestones - Work with AI-generated launch playbooks and adapt in real time based on velocity and BSR data - Brief the team on launch status and flag gates that need decisions



Inventory & Supply Chain - Monitor stock levels across Amazon FBA, Shopify, and Walmart; trigger reorders before stockouts - Manage supplier relationships (primarily China) — POs, lead times, QC, shipments - Coordinate freight forwarders and customs documentation - Own seasonal forecasting for Q4, CNY, and promotional periods



Fulfillment & Orders - Oversee Amazon MCF, Shopify, Faire, and Walmart order fulfillment - Track inbound shipments and resolve receiving issues with Amazon - Handle escalations — missing units, damaged inventory, MCF failures



Financial Operations - Track invoices, match POs, flag discrepancies - Monitor Amazon reimbursements, storage fees, and fee audits - Support cash flow planning for upcoming POs



Requirements????

Must-Have - 3+ years in Amazon e-commerce — PPC management and supply chain management are non-negotiable - Hands-on Amazon Seller Central experience (campaigns, deals, shipments, reimbursements) - Comfortable working with AI-generated analysis — you use AI tools daily, you know when to trust the output and when to push back, and you make faster decisions because of it (not despite it) - Strong analytical skills — comfortable reading dashboards, spotting trends, making data-driven calls - Detail-oriented with a bias for action — you close loops without being chased - Excellent written English



Strong Plus - Walmart Seller Center / Walmart Advertising experience - Experience with product launches on Amazon (honeymoon period, Vine, rank tracking) - Familiarity with tools like Helium 10, DataDive, or similar keyword/rank platforms - Shopify experience - Experience in a lean, remote-first team



Who Thrives Here????

You work best when given clear goals and autonomy. You're comfortable with AI handling the heavy analysis — your job is to review, d
, and execute. You don't need to be managed; you manage up. You're energized by owning a growing brand, not just executing tasks.



What We Offer????

Full ownership of a critical, high-visibility function

Direct access to the business owner

AI-powered systems that do the grunt work — your time goes to judgment and execution

Fully remote with flexible hours

Competitive salary based on experience

nt

Source public event clips, news interviews, archival material, paparazzi footage, royalty-free assets, and other relevant media with patience, precision, and a researcher’s mindset

Lower thirds

Callouts

Timelines

Maps

Headlines

Social media screenshots

Visual explainers

Title cards

Segment cards

Channel logo concepts

Brand color palettes

Typography selection

Simple brand guidelines

Template creation for recurring videos

Visual identity improvements

Design related creative assets when needed, such as:

End screens

Subscribe graphics

Social media graphics

Promotional visuals

Branded overlays

Maintain an organized shared asset library

Meet daily deadlines without needing constant follow-up

Communicate promptly and professionally during working hours

CapCut

Premiere Pro motion tools

DaVinci Fusion

CapCut motion features

or equivalent software

Strong thumbnail, graphic design, and branding skills using:

Photoshop

Illustrator

Canva

Photopea

Figma

or similar design tools

Ability to design logos, YouTube banners, channel graphics, and branded visual assets

Strong design sense — layout, typography, color, contrast, emotional framing, visual hierarchy, and composition

Strong research ability and patience to source precise, relevant footage for 25–35 minute scripts

Ability to find the exact clip or 
nt needed, not just something “close enough”

High attention to detail — visuals must match narration exactly

Example: If the narrator says “the garden party in 2018,” the footage on screen should reflect that specific 
nt, not a random garden party

B-roll sourcing experience from stock libraries, YouTube archives, public media, news clips, and event footage

A reliable workstation with capable specs and fast internet for long-form video projects

Good English comprehension — all scripts and voiceovers are in English

Full-time commitment — 6 days/week, 8 hours/day

title: AI Data Specialist
description:
This is not a role for someone who “uses ChatGPT.”



We are looking for an AI freak.



You should be the person on the team who is constantly testing new models, tools, workflows, prompting techniques, agents, automations, and ways to use AI to produce better work faster.



If a new major AI model or tool launches, your natural reaction should be:



“I need to test this.”



Not because AI is trendy, but because you genuinely enjoy understanding what these systems can do, where they fail, and how to build better workflows around them.



You should already be highly comfortable with tools such as:



ChatGPT

Claude

Gemini

Perplexity and AI research tools

AI coding / building tools

AI automation and agentic workflows

New AI tools as they emerge



You should understand that different models are good at different things and know how to choose the right model, context, workflow, and level of human oversight for the task.



AI concepts you should understand



If several of the concepts below are completely unfamiliar to you, please do not apply:



Context windows

Tokens and token limits

Hallucinations

System prompts vs. user prompts

Structured outputs

Few-shot prompting

Chain-of-thought / reasoning models

Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)

Embeddings and semantic search

Tool / function calling

AI agents and agentic workflows

Model context protocols such as MCP

LLM evaluations / evals

Prompt injection and basic AI security considerations

API-based AI workflows

Automation platforms and webhooks



You do not need to be an ML engineer.



You do need enough technical curiosity to understand these concepts, experiment with them, and figure things out without needing someone to hold your hand.



How we expect you to use AI



You will use AI for:



Research and deep research

Research synthesis

Competitor analysis

Customer research

Analyzing hundreds or thousands of reviews and comments

Extracting patterns from transcripts and qualitative data

Brainstorming angles and hypotheses

Building messaging frameworks

Creating and improving outlines

Drafting and editing

Content repurposing

Data analysis

Building internal knowledge bases

Creating repeatable workflows

Automating repetitive work

Testing new approaches to content production



But there is an important distinction:



AI should multiply your judgment—not replace it.



We are absolutely NOT looking for someone whose workflow is:



Prompt ChatGPT ? Copy ? Paste ? Publish.



You should be able to recognize when an LLM is hallucinating, being generic, repeating itself, making unsupported assumptions, missing important context, or producing something that simply isn't good enough.



You should know how to interrogate the output, change the approach, provide better context, verify claims, restructure arguments, combine multiple sources, and apply your own judgment.



Ideally, you are already building your own AI workflows rather than using AI exclusively through a basic chat interface.



We want someone who asks questions like:



“Can I turn this workflow into an agent?”



“Can I give the model better context?”



“Should this information live in a retrieval system instead of the prompt?”



“How can I evaluate whether this output is actually getting better?”



“Can I automate 80% of this while keeping human judgment on the 20% that matters?”



That mindset is extremely important for this role.



WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR



The right person is probably a slightly unusual combination:



Writer + Strategist + Researcher + Operator + AI Nerd.



You are creative, but extremely organized.



You enjoy writing, but you're not “just a writer.”



You enjoy digging through messy information and finding patterns other people miss.



You enjoy understanding customers.



You enjoy figuring out why people buy.



You enjoy experimenting.



You enjoy systems and processes.



And you are genuinely obsessed with what AI makes possible.



Your browser probably has too many tabs open because you're testing some new AI model, agent framework, research tool, automation, or workflow that might save three hours next week. Start your application with Kumusta to make sure you read the job posting. 



We don't need an AI influencer.



We don't need someone who can repeat AI buzzwords.



We need someone who actually uses this stuff.



You should be comfortable receiving:



50 pages of research

Competitor websites

Hundreds of customer reviews

Interview transcripts

Existing content

Analytics

A rough business objective



…and turning that mess into:



Organized Research ? Insights ? Strategy ? Offer ? Messaging ? Outline ? Content ? Landing Page ? Testing ? Improvement



Then looking at the entire process and asking:



“What parts of this can AI make 10x better?”



If that sounds exciting rather than overwhelming, you may be exactly who we're looking for.

title: AI Customer Service Operator - Advanced AI User, Fast, Sharp, Ecommerce
description:
We are hiring a part-time Customer Service Operator for a DTC ecommerce brand.



This role is for someone who already uses AI as part of their real work, not someone who only pastes one basic prompt into ChatGPT and copies the answer.



We use an AI-assisted customer support workflow plus Commslayer / Re:amaze. We will train you on our tools and process, but we need someone who is already strong at using AI to think, check, rewrite, summarize, organize, and improve support work.



You will review AI-drafted customer support replies before they are sent. Your job is to catch wrong AI answers, check customer/order/subscription details, rewrite replies in a human way, spot refund or chargeback risk, and escalate issues before they become bigger problems.



WORK SETUP



- Paid part-time trial to start

- 4 hours per day

- Starting rate: $4/hour

- Stable work if the trial goes well

- Possible increase in hours later based on volume, speed, quality, and reliability



WHAT YOU WILL DO



- Review AI-generated customer support drafts

- Rewrite replies so they sound clear, direct, and human

- Check order, billing, subscription, and customer context before replying

- Handle issues like refunds, cancellations, tracking, damaged items, wrong items, disputes, and angry customers

- Use AI to summarize long threads, draft replies, improve macros, organize patterns, and speed up work

- Catch AI mistakes before they reach customers

- Flag repeat issues, unclear policies, and risky tickets to the team

- Work inside Commslayer / Re:amaze after training



REQUIREMENTS



- Strong written English

- Uses AI every day for real tasks

- Can show how you use AI, not just say you use it

- Can think clearly when facts change

- Can catch hallucinations, bad assumptions, and weak AI replies

- Comfortable with ecommerce customer issues

- Fast without being sloppy

- Proactive when information is missing

- Reliable internet and computer setup

- Available for 4 hours per day



Experience with Shopify, Re:amaze, Gorgias, Zendesk, Freshdesk, subscriptions, payment disputes, or DTC brands is a plus.



YOU ARE PROBABLY NOT A FIT IF



- You only use AI to fix grammar

- You need someone to give you perfect prompts before you can use AI

- You copy AI answers without checking facts

- You cannot explain why you changed an AI draft

- You give long generic answers instead of clear decisions

- You do not like customer support work



IMPORTANT



You may use AI to apply. We expect that.



But we are judging how you use it.



We want to see your workflow, judgment, and editing. A polished AI answer with weak thinking will not pass.



HOW TO APPLY



Do not send a generic cover letter.



Use this exact subject line:



AI-CS | [Your First Name] | [Main AI Tool You Use] | [Number of minutes spent]



Reply with the following:



1. Confirm that $4/hour for 4 hours per day works for you.



2. In 5 bullets or less, describe how you used AI in the last 7 days for real work. Be specific. Name the tool and what you did with it.



Example of a weak answer:

"I use ChatGPT to help me write better
s."



Example of a stronger answer:

"I uploaded a long customer thread into Claude, asked it to extract the timeline, checked the order details myself, then used it to draft 3 reply options and rewrote the final one."



3. List 3 AI workflows or features you use beyond basic chat prompts.



Examples:

- Uploading files/screenshots and asking AI to analyze them

- Creating reusable reply frameworks or macros

- Comparing two drafts and asking AI to find risk

- Summarizing long customer threads into timelines

- Turning messy notes into SOPs

- Using projects, custom instructions, saved context, or structured templates

- Using AI with spreadsheets, CSVs, support exports, or reports

- Using automations, API tools, Zapier/Make, or similar



4. Practical task:



Customer message:

"I cancelled two weeks ago but you charged me again today. I already
ed support and nobody replied. If this is not refunded today, I am filing a dispute."



Account facts:

- Subscription status still shows active

- Billing history shows a charge today

- Customer
ed 10 days ago asking how to cancel

- No support agent replied to that

- You do not yet know if the customer clicked the cancellation button



Bad AI draft:

"Hi, your subscription was still active, so the charge is valid. Please cancel your subscription from your account page to avoid future charges."



Answer:

- What are the biggest problems with the AI draft?

- What would you check before replying?

- Write the reply you would send.

- What would you tell the manager if you saw 15 tickets like this today?



5. AI workflow proof:



Show how you used AI to answer the practical task above.



Send either:

- A short Loom/video link showing your AI workflow, or

- Screenshots of your AI conversation, or

- The exact prompts you used and how you changed the final answer.



Do not include private client/customer information.



6. Send 2 time windows when you are available for a live practical interview.



The live interview will include one section where you answer without AI and one section where you are allowed to use AI while sharing your workflow.



Applications that do not follow the format will not be considered.

title: YOUTUBE VIDEO EDITOR + THUMBNAIL DESIGNER — BODYCAM / TRUE CRIME
description:
# YOUTUBE VIDEO EDITOR + THUMBNAIL DESIGNER — BODYCAM / TRUE CRIME



**Job Title:** YouTube Video Editor + Thumbnail Designer – Bodycam Content

**Employment Type:** Part-Time / Freelance

**Work:** Remote

**Pay:** **$50 USD per completed video**

**Video Length:** 15–20 minutes

**Raw Footage:** 2–5+ hours provided per case

**Expected Editing Time:** Up to approximately 3 hours per video

**Long-Term Opportunity:** Yes — potential full-time position



---



## ABOUT THE JOB



We are looking for a **fast, reliable, and creative YouTube Video Editor + Thumbnail Designer** to join our team and work on **police bodycam / true crime documentary-style videos.**



For each project, you will receive approximately **2–5+ hours of raw police bodycam and related footage.**



Your job will be to turn that footage into a **compelling 15–20 minute YouTube video** that keeps viewers watching.



The editing itself is **not highly complicated**. We are not looking for someone who spends 8–10 hours creating complicated cinematic effects.



Instead, we need someone who understands **storytelling, pacing, suspense, and viewer retention.**



The goal is:



**Find the best moments ? remove unnecessary footage ? build the story ? keep it raw ? create suspense ? deliver a watchable YouTube video.**



---



# YOUR MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES



### 1. EDIT 2–5+ HOURS OF RAW FOOTAGE



We will provide you with the raw footage for each case.



Your responsibility is to watch through the footage and identify the **most important, interesting, emotional, surprising, and compelling moments.**



You will turn the raw material into a finished:



**15–20 minute YouTube video.**



You should be comfortable quickly reviewing large amounts of footage and identifying what is actually important to the story.



---



# 2. KEEP THE FOOTAGE RAW



This is extremely important.



We want the videos to feel **real and authentic.**



Do not over-edit the footage.



Avoid unnecessary:



* Fancy transitions

* Excessive effects

* Over-the-top animations

* Constant zooms

* Unnecessary sound effects

* Complicated cinematic edits



The **bodycam footage itself should be the star of the video.**



Your job is primarily to make the story easier and more compelling to watch.



---



# 3. BUILD SUSPENSE AT THE BEGINNING



The first part of the video is extremely important.



We want the opening to immediately create curiosity.



Use **appropriate suspense-based background music** at the beginning when necessary to establish the mood and make viewers want to know what happens next.



The opening should make the viewer think:



**“What is going on here?”**



**“What happens next?”**



**“How did this situation end?”**



The goal is to create a strong curiosity hook without misleading the viewer.



---



# 4. AI VOICEOVER / INTRODUCTION



You will also create a **short AI voiceover introduction** when needed to provide context for the viewer.



The intro should quickly explain the basic situation and give viewers enough information to understand what they are about to watch.



For example:



* Where the incident happened

* What police were responding to

* The basic circumstances

* Why the incident became significant

* What viewers should pay attention to



Keep the introduction **short, natural, and engaging.**



Do not spend several minutes explaining the entire case before showing the footage.



---



# 5. FIND THE MOST COMPELLING CONVERSATIONS



This is one of the most important parts of the job.



While reviewing the footage, you should identify the **best conversations and interactions**.



Look for moments such as:



* Interesting conversations between officers and suspects

* Unexpected statements

* Emotional reactions

* Arguments

* Confessions

* Contradictions

* Suspicious behavior

* Important discoveries

* Officer reactions

* Moments where the situation suddenly changes



The finished video should tell a story rather than simply dumping hours of footage onto the timeline.



---



# 6. CREATE GOOD PACING



You will need to remove:



* Long periods of silence

* Repetitive conversations

* Unnecessary walking/driving

* Dead time

* Repeated information

* Unimportant portions of the incident



But don't cut so aggressively that the story becomes confusing.



The viewer should always understand:



**What is happening ? why it matters ? what happens next.**



---



# 7. THUMBNAIL DESIGN



You will also be responsible for creating a **YouTube thumbnail for each completed video.**



The thumbnail should be:



* Eye-catching

* Clear

* High quality

* Relevant to the actual case

* Easy to understand at small size

* Designed for YouTube viewers

* Focused on curiosity and strong visual storytelling



We are looking for thumbnails that make someone scrolling through YouTube stop and think:



**“Wait… what happened here?”**



You should understand basic YouTube thumbnail principles such as:



* Strong focal point

* Clear subject

* Good composition

* Minimal text

* Emotional/interesting imagery

* Strong contrast

* Curiosity



You don't need to create extremely complicated graphics.



**Simple and effective is better than overly complicated.**



---



# PAYMENT



### **$50 USD PER COMPLETED VIDEO**



You will be paid:



**$50 for each completed 15–20 minute video.**



The expected editing workload is designed to take **approximately 3 hours or less per video** once you become familiar with our workflow.



That works out to approximately **$10/hour based on the expected workload**, while giving you flexibility to work remotely.



The goal is to create a workflow where an experienced editor can complete the project efficiently rather than spending an excessive amount of time on basic editing.



---



# PLEASE READ THIS BEFORE APPLYING



### ARE YOU COMFORTABLE WITH THE $50 PER VIDEO RATE?



If the answer is **no**, please **do not apply.**



We want to be completely transparent about the compensation before you apply.



This position is intended for someone who can work efficiently and complete these videos within the expected timeframe.



If you normally charge significantly more than this rate or require more than approximately 3 hours for this type of basic editing, **this probably isn't the right position for you.**



However, if you are fast, experienced, and interested in building a long-term relationship with a growing YouTube channel, we'd love to hear from you.



---



# WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR



Our ideal editor is:



* Fast

* Reliable

* Creative

* Detail-oriented

* Good at storytelling

* Good at pacing

* Familiar with YouTube

* Comfortable editing long raw footage

* Able to identify compelling moments

* Able to work independently

* Good at creating thumbnails

* Comfortable using AI tools

* Able to meet deadlines

* Interested in long-term work



---



# EXPERIENCE WITH THESE TYPES OF VIDEOS IS A PLUS



Experience with any of the following is highly preferred:



* Police bodycam videos

* True crime

* Crime documentaries

* Police footage

* Dashcam videos

* Court/crime content

* YouTube documentary channels

* Faceless YouTube channels

* Retention-focused YouTube editing



If you've previously edited bodycam or true crime videos, **please include examples in your application.**



---



# SOFTWARE



You may use whatever professional editing software you are comfortable with, including:



* Adobe Premiere Pro

* DaVinci Resolve

* Final Cut Pro

* CapCut

* Other professional editing software



The specific software is less important to us than the **quality and speed of your work.**



You should also be comfortable using AI tools for tasks such as generating the short introductory voiceover.



---



# WORKFLOW



A typical project will look like this:



### STEP 1



We provide you with **2–5+ hours of raw footage.**



### STEP 2



You review the footage and identify the most important moments.



### STEP 3



You build the story and remove unnecessary material.



### STEP 4



You create a compelling opening with appropriate suspense music.



### STEP 5



You add a short AI voiceover introduction to provide context.



### STEP 6



You edit the bodycam footage while keeping the presentation as raw and authentic as possible.



### STEP 7



You create the YouTube thumbnail.



### STEP 8



You submit the completed video and thumbnail for review.



### STEP 9



After approval, you move on to the next case.



---



# LONG-TERM OPPORTUNITY ????



This is **not necessarily just a short-term freelance position.**



We are building a long-term YouTube production team and want to find people who can grow with us.



If I like your:



* Editing

* Storytelling

* Speed

* Reliability

* Communication

* Thumbnail quality

* Attention to detail



there is a real opportunity for you to become a **full-time editor working directly with me.**



### DO A GREAT JOB ? GET MORE OPPORTUNITIES.



If you consistently deliver excellent work, I am willing to provide **additional incentives and opportunities based on performance.**



The better you perform, the more valuable your role can become.



---



# WHY JOIN US?



You will be working directly with an experienced YouTube operation rather than a random one-off client.



We understand how YouTube works, and we are focused on building a **long-term content business.**



We are looking for people who want more than a few random freelance projects.



If you prove yourself, **I want to keep you around.**



The ultimate goal is to build a reliable team of people who can work with us **long-term and eventually full-time.**



---



# APPLICATION REQUIREMENTS



When applying, please answer the following questions:



### 1. How many years of video editing experience do you have?



### 2. Have you edited bodycam, true crime, documentary, or similar YouTube videos before?



### 3. How long would it normally take you to turn 2–5 hours of raw footage into a 15–20 minute video?



### 4. What editing software do you use?



### 5. What software/tools do you use for AI voiceovers?



### 6. Do you have experience creating YouTube thumbnails?



### 7. Please provide your portfolio or examples of your best work.



### 8. How many videos could you realistically complete per week?



### 9. Are you comfortable with the **$50 per completed video** rate?



### 10. Are you interested in eventually working full-time if the collaboration goes well?



---



# IMPORTANT



Please begin your application with:



**“BODYCAM EDITOR”**



This lets us know that you actually read the entire job description.



Applications without a portfolio or relevant work samples may not be considered.



---



## FINAL NOTE



We are looking for someone who wants to **grow with us**, not someone who is simply looking for a quick freelance job.



If you're fast, talented, reliable, and genuinely understand how to turn raw footage into a compelling YouTube story, **apply.**



If you're not comfortable with the **$50/video rate, please don't apply.**



If you are comfortable with the rate and believe you can deliver high-quality work efficiently, **we'd love to see your portfolio.**



**Do great work, and there is an opportunity to grow into a full-time position with us.**

title: Sales Development Representative (SDR)
description:
Elystra is building the revenue operating system for agencies: the infrastructure layer between a conversation and cash in the bank.



Most agencies don’t have a lead problem. They have an execution problem. Sales lives in one tool. Proposals in another. Follow-up dies in inboxes. Revenue slips through the cracks every single day.



We’re building the system that connects the entire commercial motion, from the first call to signed agreements to collected revenue, so agencies operate with discipline, visibility, and predictability.



We’re building a sales organization with the same standard: clear systems, high bars, relentless execution.



The Role



This is an outbound SDR role. One mission: generate qualified opportunities for our Account Executives.



You will speak with agency owners, identify qualified opportunities, and book demo meetings that are worth running.



You will not close deals. You will not build lead lists. You will not manage customer accounts.



You will own the first conversation, and everything that follows starts with how you open the door.



The role follows North American business hours with two primary calling blocks:



10 AM–12 PM EST

1 PM–5 PM EST



Why This Role Matters



Every customer relationship begins with an initial conversation.



The quality of our sales pipeline depends on the quality of that first interaction. Consistently generating qualified opportunities allows our Account Executives to focus on moving high-quality opportunities through the remainder of the sales process.



This role is a foundational part of Elystra’s commercial organization.



What You’ll Own



* Prospect marketing and advertising agencies across North America.

* Conduct outbound calls with business owners and decision-makers.

* Qualify opportunities using Elystra’s sales framework.

* Schedule qualified demo meetings for the Account Executive team.

* Maintain accurate CRM records following each conversation.

* Continuously improve through coaching, call reviews, and performance feedback.



We simplify the SDR experience by providing the lead lists, CRM, dialer, sales process, scripts, training, and ongoing coaching, so you can focus on execution, quality conversations, and consistent outbound performance.



What Success Looks Like



Success is measured by consistent execution.



High-performing SDRs at Elystra:



* Consistently generate qualified demo meetings.

* Maintain disciplined outbound activity.

* Apply coaching quickly and continuously improve.

* Keep CRM data accurate and current.

* Produce reliable performance week after week.



Performance expectations are transparent, measurable, and reviewed regularly.



Who Thrives Here



You’ll likely perform well in this role if you:



* Communicate confidently with business owners and decision-makers.

* Are comfortable working toward measurable performance targets.

* Learn quickly from coaching and apply feedback consistently.

* Maintain focus and professionalism throughout high-volume outbound calling.

* Want to build long-term expertise in B2B sales.



Previous SDR, BDR, appointment-setting, or outbound sales experience is valuable, but coachability and execution matter more than specific titles.



This Role Is Probably Not for You If



* You prefer unstructured work without measurable goals.

* You struggle with feedback or accountability.

* You are looking for a temporary role rather than building long-term expertise in B2B sales.



Growth



High performance creates opportunity.



SDRs who consistently produce, demonstrate sound judgment, and take ownership of their work are the first candidates considered for greater commercial responsibility.



Career progression may include:



* Account Executive

* Sales Team Lead

* Sales Manager



Advancement is based on sustained performance, execution, leadership potential, and readiness for greater responsibility, not tenure.



Compensation



Base: $600 USD/month, paid biweekly.



Tier 1 — Entry

$600/month base. Target: consistently sustain 2 qualified demos/day.



Tier 2 — Performance

$600/month base + $10 per qualified demo. Unlocked after sustaining 3 qualified demos/day for 2 consecutive weeks.



Tier 3 — High Performance

$600/month base + $20 per qualified demo. Unlocked after sustaining 4 qualified demos/day for 2 consecutive weeks.



OTE



3 qualified demos/day: approximately $1,230/month OTE



4 qualified demos/day: approximately $2,280/month OTE



5 qualified demos/day: approximately $2,700/month OTE



OTE increases with sustained performance. Higher tiers are earned through demonstrated production, not tenure.

title: Airtable CRM Builder / Recruiting VA

Ideal Candidate

title: Content Editor & Strategist
description:
Content Editor & Strategist 



JOB TITLE: Content Editor & Strategist 



TYPE: Full time, remote, long term



HOURS: 40 hours per week, with some overlap with New York hours



SALARY: $800 to $1,100/month depending on experience



Read the whole post. There's an application instruction at the bottom and I skip anyone who misses it.



WHO WE ARE



A family-owned jeweler in New York City's Diamond District. Diamonds, engagement rings, and luxury watches, made in our own shop.



The footage is good and it's the kind most brands can't get. A real workshop, a real trading floor, and customers having the biggest day of their life on camera. Right now I shoot and edit all of it myself, and the editing is what's slowing everything down.



THE ROLE, IN ONE SENTENCE



I shoot. You make it good and tell me what to shoot next.



WHAT YOU'LL DO



Editing:



Cut short-form video for Reels, TikTok, and YouTube Shorts

Turn one shoot into several genuinely different videos, each with its own hook

Captions, on-screen text, pacing, sound, hook timing

Native edits per platform, no watermarked cross-posts

Keep the footage library organized



Strategy:



Watch the market weekly and bring me formats that are working before I ask

Bring me shoot ideas every week, not just execution of mine

Watch retention, sends, and non-follower reach, and tell me in plain language what you're seeing

Tell me when an idea is bad or a hook is weak. I'd rather argue for ten minutes than post something flat



WHO I'M LOOKING FOR



Someone who thinks like a creator, not a service provider.



Real short-form editing experience with links to prove it

You use TikTok and Reels yourself and have opinions about what's working

Strong written English. You'll be writing hooks and captions in an American voice

Organized and self-directed



You don't need a film degree, a jewelry background, or expensive gear. Most of our footage is shot on a phone on purpose.



WHO I'M NOT LOOKING FOR



An editor who slaps auto-captions on a clip, cuts wherever, adds a trending sound for no reason, and sends it back. That's the job I'm trying to stop doing myself.



I'm also not looking for someone who only ever agrees with me.



WHY THIS IS A GOOD ONE



Full time, stable, long term, with a real budget behind it

Tools and subscriptions paid for

You work directly with me. No layers, no account manager, no client calls

Your ideas actually get shot. This is a creative seat, not a queue

A luxury brand and a category you'll be proud to put in your portfolio

Raises tied to results

Path to leading a small content team



HOW TO APPLY



Two or three links to short-form videos you edited. One line each on what you were going for.

Answer this: pick any jewelry or luxury brand on TikTok or Instagram. Tell me one thing they're doing that works and one thing you'd change. Three sentences.

Start your message with the word DIAMOND.



Anything missing all three gets skipped.

title: Short-Form Video Clipper + Social Media Scheduler (Long-Term)
description:
## About the job



I run an online education brand teaching first-time buyers how to purchase

their first property. I record a lot — long-form live sessions and batches of

short scripts — and I need one reliable person to turn that raw footage into

scheduled, published short-form content.



You are not creating content. You are moving my content through a system I

have already built. Everything you need — the clips, the caption templates,

the posting times, the tracker — will be handed to you.



## What you will do each week



- Take 1–2 raw recordings (a 30–60 minute live, or a batch of short scripts)

- Cut them into 10–20 vertical clips. For scripted batches I give you the exact

  start and end phrases, so there is no guessing

- Check every clip before it goes out: captions spelled correctly, the hook

  lands in the first 2 seconds, the call-to-action is never cut off mid-sentence

- Burn in captions — large, high contrast, bottom third, 3–4 words per line

- Write a caption and a pinned comment for each clip **using my templates**

- Schedule everything through GoHighLevel Social Planner to YouTube Shorts,

  Instagram Reels, TikTok, and
 at the times I specify

- Log every post in a simple tracker: platform, date, views, saves, comments

- Send me a short Friday summary: what went out, what didn't, and why



## What I care about



- **Accuracy over speed.** A clip with a misspelled caption or a cut-off ending

  is worse than no clip at all.

- **You follow the brief.** I give exact instructions. I am not looking for

  creative reinterpretation of my message.

- **You tell me when you don't know.** "I'm not sure, let me find out" is the

  single trait I hire for. Guessing quietly is the one thing that ends the

  arrangement.

- **You tell me when something didn't get done.** I would much rather hear

  "I missed two clips" than find out on my own.



## What I do NOT need



- Someone to write my content or change my message

- Fancy transitions, stock footage, background music, or zoom effects.

  Clean and plain.

- AI-generated video, AI voiceover, or AI-written captions. My audience is

  watching for signs of fakery and it would cost me their trust.



## Rules that are not negotiable



- Never promise or imply a guaranteed result, income, or outcome in any caption

  or comment. Not once, not anywhere. If a template ever seems to, stop and ask.

- Never invent numbers, prices, or claims that aren't in the material I gave you.

- Never respond to comments or messages on my behalf unless I ask you to.



## Requirements



- Experience with CapCut, Descript, Opus Clip, Vizard, or similar

- Strong written English — you'll be adapting captions from my templates

- Reliable weekly turnaround: 48 hours from when I send you raw footage

- Comfortable being told exactly how to do something

- Stable internet and a computer that can handle video editing



**Nice to have:** experience with GoHighLevel, or with personal-finance,

faith-based, or coaching creators.



## What you get fro



- Every tool and account you need, paid for by me

- Written SOPs for each step. You will never have to guess the process

- Clear templates for captions, comments, and posting times

- Direct communication. No layers, no middle manager

- Long-term work. I am hiring one person to grow with this brand, not to fill

  a gap for a month



## How to apply



### ???? [Apply Here](
)



Do not reply to this post. Do not message me on the platform. Do not
 me.

Applications that arrive any other way are not read — following the instruction

is the first part of the job.



Before you open the form, take the free IQ test and the free DISC personality

test on your OnlineJobs.ph profile. The form asks for both.



The form has instructions inside it. Read every word. Most applicants will miss

them. That is intentional.

it exists yet. That's exactly why these calls work.



We're hiring one experienced cold caller to book 30-minute audit calls with

Australian business owners. You call, you book, you hand over. No closing, no

demos, no pricing conversations, no chasing payment.



DAY SHIFT. WE CALL AUSTRALIA, NOT THE US.

Melbourne business hours are roughly 7:00 AM - 3:00 PM Manila time. You work

mornings, you keep your evenings, and you sleep at night. If you have been

grinding US graveyard shifts, read that again.



WHAT MAKES THESE CALLS DIFFERENT

Most businesses you call have already been researched before you dial. We check

whether AI assistants recommend them, and which of their competitors get

recommended instead. You will have that in front of you on the call. You are not

opening with "how are you today" — you are opening with something specific and

true about their business that they did not know this morning.



WHAT YOU WILL DO
dials per 4-hour shift from lists we provide

WHAT WE PROVIDE

YOU NEED

title: Aluminum fabricator
description:
Location: Ilocos Norte, Philippines

Reports to: Workshop Supervisor / Project Manager

Employment Type: Full-time / Contract / On-site

 

 

 

Job Summary

 

An Aluminum Fabricator measures, cuts, shapes, assembles, and installs aluminum materials for windows, doors, frames, curtain walls, railings, signboards, furniture, and custom structures. You will work from technical drawings or client specifications, operate hand and power tools safely, and ensure finished work meets quality standards, building codes, and client requirements.

 

 

 

Key Responsibilities

 

1. Preparation & Measurement

 

- Read and interpret blueprints, sketches, layout plans, and work orders accurately.

?

- Take precise field measurements at installation sites and cross-check with design specifications.

?

- Select the right type, thickness, and grade of aluminum profiles, sheets, and accessories (glass, fasteners, hinges, locks, sealants).

 

2. Fabrication & Machining

 

- Operate tools safely: miter saws, circular saws, drills, grinders, routers, punch machines, and bending equipment.

?

- Cut, drill, mill, bend, and punch aluminum to exact dimensions; smooth and finish sharp edges.

?

- Assemble components using rivets, screws, bolts, adhesives, or welding (TIG/MIG for aluminum when required).

?

- Fit and align parts to ensure proper operation (e.g., smooth opening/closing of doors/windows).

 

3. Installation & Finishing

 

- Transport fabricated items to the site and prepare installation areas.

?

- Mount and secure aluminum structures to walls, floors, or frames using anchors and brackets.

?

- Install accessories: glass panels, locks, handles, gaskets, weather seals, and trim.

?

- Apply protective finishes, sealants, or coatings to prevent corrosion and improve appearance.

?

- Clean work areas and remove waste materials after completion.

 

4. Quality & Safety

 

- Inspect materials and finished products for defects, damage, or dimensional accuracy.

?

- Follow all workplace safety rules; use PPE (safety goggles, gloves, ear protection, dust masks, steel-toe shoes).

?

- Maintain tools and equipment; report damaged or faulty items immediately.

?

- Keep workshop and job sites tidy and organized.

 

5. Other Duties

 

- Coordinate with clients, contractors, and other team members to resolve on-site issues.

?

- Estimate material quantities and time needed for tasks when requested.

?

- Follow local building codes and safety regulations (e.g., Philippine National Building Code).

 

 

 

Qualifications & Requirements

 

Education & Experience

 

- High school diploma or equivalent; vocational training in welding, fabrication, or carpentry is preferred.

?

- 1–3 years of proven experience in aluminum fabrication and installation (fresh graduates with strong skills may be considered).

?

- Familiarity with common aluminum systems and profiles used in the Philippines.

 

Skills & Abilities

 

- Ability to read basic drawings and take accurate measurements.

?

- Hands-on experience with standard fabrication tools and equipment.

?

- Basic math skills for calculations, angles, and material estimates.

?

- Attention to detail, good eye-hand coordination, and steady hands.

?

- Physical fitness: able to stand for long periods, lift heavy materials, and work at heights (with safety gear).

?

- Reliable, responsible, and able to work independently or as part of a team.

?

- Valid driver’s license is an advantage.

 

 

 

Working Conditions

 

- Work is split between a workshop and outdoor/indoor construction sites; may involve working at heights or in hot weather.

?

- Exposure to noise, dust, and metal shavings—strict use of PPE is required.

?

- Occasional weekend or extended hours to meet project deadlines.

 

 

 

Compensation & Benefits

 

(Local Ilocos Norte standards)

 

- Competitive monthly salary based on experience and skill level.

?

title: Creative strategist - Ecom Brands
description:
# Creative Strategist – Native Ads (Proven Results Required)



We’re looking for a **high-level Creative Strategist who specializes in creating and scaling high-performing native ads**.



This is **NOT** a role for someone who simply makes attractive ads or has a strong design portfolio. We want someone who understands **what makes native advertising perform** and can prove it with real results.



### What We’re Looking For



You should have a strong track record creating native ads that have generated measurable results across platforms such as:



* Meta /



You should understand how to create ads that **feel native to the platform while still driving strong clicks, engagement, conversions, and revenue.**



### Your Responsibilities



* Develop creative strategies for native advertising campaigns

* Research audiences, competitors, trends, and winning creative angles

* Develop compelling hooks, concepts, scripts, headlines, and ad structures

* Identify new angles and concepts based on performance data

* Analyse existing creatives and determine why they are or aren't working

* Develop multiple creative variations for testing

### PROOF OF RESULTS IS REQUIRED

When applying, you MUST provide:



1. **At least 3 examples of native ads you have worked on**

2. The actual ads/creative examples, where possible

3. The platform(s) they ran on

4. Your specific role in creating the strategy/creative

5. The results they achieved



For each example, please provide as much of the following as you can:



* Spend

* Revenue

* ROAS

* CPA / CPL

* CTR

* Conversion rate

* Number of conversions

* Campaign duration

* How long the creative remained profitable

* Any other meaningful performance metrics



**Screenshots, dashboards, case studies, or other verifiable evidence of performance are strongly preferred.**



Please do not simply send us a portfolio of attractive advertisements. **We care about performance, not aesthetics alone.**



If you cannot publicly disclose the brand, you can anonymise the company/product — but we still want to see the creative and evidence of the results where possible.



### The Ideal Candidate



You are:



* A performance-focused creative strategist

* Experienced specifically with **native advertising**

* Obsessed with testing hooks, angles, concepts, and creative variations

* Strong at understanding consumer psychology

* Comfortable analysing performance data

* Able to explain *why* an ad worked, not just that it worked

* Able to turn data into new creative concepts

* Experienced working with direct-response advertising

* Constantly studying winning ads and creative trends



### Bonus If You Have Experience With



* Advertorials

* UGC-style native ads

* Direct-response advertising

* E-commerce

* DTC brands

* Lead generation

* Subscription businesses

* Health/wellness

* Beauty

* Finance

* Information products

* High-ticket offers

* Scaling paid acquisition



### Important: Quality Over Quantity



We are **not** looking for someone who produces hundreds of generic concepts.



We want a strategist who can identify **high-potential creative angles**, understand the psychology behind them, and develop concepts with a strong probability of becoming winners.



We would rather work with someone who can show us **5 genuinely successful ads** than someone with a portfolio of 500 ads with no performance data.



### How to Apply



Please start your application with:



**“I specialise in performance-driven native ads.”**



Then answer the following:



**1. What is the best-performing native ad you have personally worked on?**



Tell us:



* What was the product/offer?

* What was your role?

* What was the creative concept?

* How much was spent?

* What results did it generate?



**2. Give us 2–3 additional examples of successful native ads you've worked on.**



**3. Show us your proof of results.**



Screenshots, dashboards, case studies, or other evidence are preferred. Please anonymise sensitive information if necessary.



**4. What do you believe makes a native ad outperform a traditional-looking advertisement?**



**5. If we gave you a new product tomorrow, how would you approach developing the first 10 creative concepts?**



### Selection Process



We will prioritise candidates based on:



**1. Proven performance results**

**2. Quality of previous native ads**

**3. Understanding of creative strategy and consumer psychology**

**4. Ability to explain the reasoning behind successful creatives**

**5. Ability to develop new winning concepts**



We may ask shortlisted candidates to complete a **small paid test project** before beginning a longer-term engagement.



### Long-Term Opportunity



If you can consistently develop native creatives that outperform our existing ads, there is significant potential for **ongoing, long-term work and increased responsibility**.



We are looking for someone who wants to become a key creative partner to the business — not someone who simply wants to deliver a few ads and move on.



**If you have the results to back up your work, we want to see them.**

title: Communications Integration Engineer
description:
Communications Integration Engineer – Twilio or Similar



We are seeking an experienced **Communications Integration Engineer** to integrate Twilio or a similar cloud communications platform into an existing web application.



The primary goal is to enable users to **make and receive phone calls directly through the application** while automatically tracking call activity, recordings, statuses, and communication history.



We are open to solutions using **Twilio platform**. The ideal candidate should be able to recommend the best solution based on reliability, scalability, security, functionality, and cost.



## Responsibilities



* Integrate Twilio or a similar communications platform with our web application

* Build outbound calling directly from within the application

* Configure inbound calling and call routing

* Implement browser-based calling where appropriate

* Configure phone numbers and user-level call routing

* Develop secure backend API integrations

* Configure webhooks and call-status callbacks

* Capture and store call activity within the application

* Implement call recording functionality

* Associate calls with the appropriate customer, provider, and application user

* Track call duration, timestamps, direction, status, and outcomes

* Implement error handling, monitoring, and logging

* Troubleshoot call routing, audio, API, authentication, and connectivity issues

* Perform end-to-end testing

* Support production deployment

* Document the integration and architecture



## Desired Workflow



A user should be able to:



**Open a customer or provider profile ? Click Call ? Make the call through the application ? Complete the conversation ? Have the call automatically logged in the platform.**



Receive calls that routes to the application allowing employees to answer calls on the application



The system should capture information including:



* Caller

* Recipient

* Phone number

* User initiating the call

* Customer/provider associated with the call

* Call start and end time

* Call duration

* Call status

* Call direction

* Platform Call ID

* Recording information

* Failed-call reason when applicable



## Required Qualifications



* Experience integrating **Twilio or another cloud telephony/CPaaS platform**

* Strong experience with REST APIs

* Experience implementing webhooks

* Experience with voice APIs

* Experience with JavaScript/TypeScript and modern backend development

* Understanding of API authentication and credential security

* Experience integrating third-party services with web applications

* Strong debugging and troubleshooting skills

* Ability to independently design and implement integration architecture



## Preferred Experience



Experience with any of the following is a plus:



* Twilio Programmable Voice

* Browser-based calling

* Call recording

* Call transcription

* SMS APIs

* CRM integrations

* Base44

* Supabase

* Healthcare applications

* HIPAA-conscious architecture

* AI/LLM integrations



## Future Functionality



The integration should be designed to support future capabilities such as:



* Automatic call transcription

* AI-generated call summaries

* Sentiment analysis

* Automatic CRM notes

* Follow-up task creation

* SMS communication

* Call analytics

* Automated outbound calling

* AI voice agents



## Project Deliverables



The selected engineer will be responsible for delivering a production-ready integration that includes:



* Working outbound calling

* Inbound calling/routing where applicable

* Call-status tracking

* Call history within the application

* Recording functionality

* Secure API and webhook architecture

* Database integration

* Logging and error handling

* End-to-end testing

* Technical documentation

* Production deployment support



## Ideal Candidate



We are looking for someone who has **previously built cloud calling integrations** and can take ownership of the project from architecture through deployment.

title: Senior Recruiter - US Healthcare (Imaging/Allied) - Night Shift, Remote
description:
US-based direct-hire healthcare recruiting firm is hiring a Senior Recruiter (full-cycle, voice) for our imaging/allied and physician desks. We hand you pre-sourced, pre-verified candidate worklists every shift (our AI engine builds the pools — sourcing is NOT your bottleneck). You get US healthcare candidates on the PHONE, screen them properly, verify their credentials, write a submit-ready candidate packet, and book the submission with our US team. All candidates you recruit are US-based clinicians (radiologic technologists, CT/MRI techs, sonographers, surgical techs, respiratory therapists, physicians); all clients are US hospitals and health systems. Fully remote, Philippines-based, long-term.



This is a senior seat with a real quota and real commission: you own the screened-submission number for your desk, starting at 5 screened submissions/week and ramping to 10. Every placement you make pays you a commission on top of base.



WHAT YOU DO DAILY:

- Work the AI-generated worklist: call US imaging/allied and physician candidates (we provide the phone system; allied-health candidates prefer phone — that's why this is a voice seat).

- Run a structured recruiter screen: motivation, compensation expectations, licensure, timeline, fit against the live req.

- Verify credentials before any submission (ARRT, ARDMS/RDMS/RDCS/RVT, CST, CRCST, RRT, state licenses — our screen-and-credential gate; nothing unverified goes to a client).

- Write a tight, submit-ready candidate packet (summary, credentials, comp, availability, why-this-req) and book the client submission with the US team.

- Keep the ATS honest: every call, every disposition, same day.



REQUIRED:

- 3+ years US healthcare AGENCY recruiting (imaging/allied, nursing, or physician desks — agency/staffing side, not internal HR). Imaging/allied depth is a strong plus: you should know what ARRT, RDMS, or CST mean without looking them up.

- Proven PERSONAL production numbers you can state and defend — your own submissions, interviews, and placements for a recent quarter (not your team's). We verify on the interview.

- You have personally phone-screened US candidates end-to-end — this is not a sourcing-only or
-only seat.

- Excellent spoken English for US phone screens — clear, confident, professional. This is the #1 requirement and there WILL be a live spoken check.

- Can work the FIXED US night shift long-term (9:00 PM-6:00 AM PHT, Mon-Fri) with a reliable home setup (quiet room, headset, stable internet, backup power/data).

- Disciplined ATS usage — honest pipeline reporting, no ghost activity.



COMPENSATION: $1,000-$1,300/month base (by experience and proven production; night differential included) + monthly performance commission on every placement you close — commission specifics discussed at offer. Paid via Wise, reliable and on time.



DO NOT APPLY IF: you have never recruited for US healthcare accounts; your experience is sourcing/research only and you've never personally phone-screened and submitted a candidate; you can't state your own submission/interview/placement numbers; your spoken English isn't strong enough for live US candidate calls; you can't commit to the fixed US night shift; or your only healthcare exposure is BPO customer service / claims processing (this is a recruiting seat, not a support seat).



WHY US: the sourcing grind is already done for you — our AI engine hands you verified candidate pools every day, so your time goes to the high-value work (screening, closing candidates, placements = commission). Competitive base at the top of the market, fully remote, long-term, with a clear path Senior Recruiter ? Desk Lead as the team grows.



TO APPLY, ANSWER ALL SIX (applications missing any of these will not be reviewed):

1. Describe your US healthcare AGENCY recruiting experience: which agency/agencies, how many years, which desks (imaging/allied, nursing, physician, other), and direct-hire (permanent) vs travel/contract mix.

2. Your REAL personal numbers for one recent quarter (your own, not your team's): submissions made, candidate interviews set, placements closed, and the typical candidate salary or fee level. (We verify these on the call — honest ranges beat inflated exact numbers.)

3. Name the credential(s) a US hospital requires for each of these three roles, in your own words (no lookup): a CT technologist, a cardiac sonographer (echo), and a surgical technologist. Add one sentence on why imaging/allied roles are chronically hard for hospitals to fill.

4. Include a LINK to a 60-90 second voice recording: the OPENING of a mock recruiter screen call to a US radiologic technologist ("Hi, this is ___ calling about the CT tech opening in Colorado...") — introduce yourself, set the agenda, and ask your first two screening questions. (This is the single most important part of your application.)

5. Can you commit to a FIXED US night shift (9:00 PM-6:00 AM PHT), Mon-Fri, long-term? (Yes/No + any constraint.) And your home setup: internet speed, headset, quiet room, backup power/internet — Y/N each.

6. Current/most-recent monthly pay (PHP or USD), your expected monthly base, and earliest start date.
