title: Bookkeeping Catch-Up Specialist — Short-Term Contract
description:
Company: Showcase Listings Media — real estate media (photo, video, drone, Matterport, floor plans, social media management), Jacksonville, FL 



Engagement type: Project-based contract (1099). Not part-time, not full-time — a defined cleanup project with a hard finish line. 

Location: Fully remote. Jacksonville / North Florida preferred but not required. Timeline: Start within one week of hire. Catch-up complete within 3 weeks of receiving access. 

Pay: $TBD, but will be flat for the catch-up projec. See "Compensation" below. 

Continuation: Strong possibility of an ongoing monthly close retainer if the catch-up goes well.



What this is



Our books have not been maintained since February 2026. We are profitable and busy — the accounting simply fell behind while the business grew and other matters took priority. We need someone to reconstruct the books from February 1, 2026 through the current month, and hand them back to us clean, reconciled, and current. I do have a template made and ready to go. 



We already have the destination built: a structured Excel workbook with a chart of accounts, a transaction ledger, a job log, a payroll log, a monthly P&L, and a dashboard with month-over-month and ROI metrics. You are not designing a system. You are populating and reconciling an existing one. Every formula, category, and output already exists.



If you would rather work in QuickBooks Online and mirror the results into the workbook, we are open to that — tell us in your proposal and quote it accordingly.



Scope of work



1. Intake and setup



Receive read-only exports and/or accountant access to business checking, business savings, business credit card, Stripe/Aryeo payout reports, and payroll records.

Review the existing chart of accounts and flag anything missing for a real estate media business before you begin coding.



2. Reconstruct February 2026 to current



Import and categorize every transaction across all accounts for each month, February forward.

Reconcile each month to the actual ending statement balance. A month is not done until it ties.

Separate direct job costs (contract shooters, outsourced editing, virtual staging vendors, platform and processing fees) from operating overhead. This distinction drives our gross margin, so it has to be right.

Code owner draws, owner contributions, credit card payments, and transfers below the line so they never touch profit.

Identify equipment purchases that should be capitalized rather than expensed, and flag them for review.

Track legal and professional fees to their own line — we report on the business with and without that spend.



3. Revenue tied to jobs



Populate the job log from our Aryeo order data: one row per shoot, with gross invoice, platform and processing fees, and shooter/editor cost.

Tie job-level revenue to actual deposits. Where they diverge, document why rather than forcing them to match.



4. Payroll and contractors



Log every pay run by person: gross wages, employer taxes, and service fees, for two part-time tea
mbers, and 1099 contractors.

Confirm each pay run is also reflected in the transaction ledger so it lands in the P&L.

Flag any 1099 contractor tracking gaps that will matter at year end.



5. Deliver



The completed workbook with every month February forward closed, and the uncategorized-dollars check reading zero across the board.

A short written summary: month-by-month revenue, gross profit, operating expenses, and net profit or loss.

An open-items list — anything you could not resolve, anything that needs a receipt or an explanation from us, and anything you would code differently with more information.



What you need to have



Required



3+ years of small business bookkeeping, with real cleanup and catch-up experience specifically. Reconstructing a partial year is a different skill than maintaining a current set of books, and we need the former.

Full-charge capability: bank and credit card reconciliation, accrual vs. cash judgment, and comfort building a chart of accounts out when it needs it.

Strong Excel. You need to work inside a formula-driven workbook without breaking it, and understand SUMIFS and structured references well enough to know why a number moved.

Ability to work from raw bank and platform exports rather than a tidy handoff. Some of this will require judgment calls and questions.



Nice to have



Experience with service businesses that bill per job or per project — photography, videography, creative agencies, trades, or similar.

Familiarity with Stripe payout reporting or a job-management platform like Aryeo.

Small business experience.



Non-negotiable



Discretion. You will see the full financial picture of a small business, including legal spend. A signed NDA is a condition of engagement.

Responsiveness. Reply within one business day during the project.

You do the work yourself. No subcontracting or offshoring without disclosure and written approval.



Compensation



Two structures — tell us which you prefer and why.



Option A — Flat project fee: Propose your flat fee. Covers the full catch-up from February 2026 to current, all reconciliations, the populated workbook, the summary, the open-items list, and the handoff call. Priced at the upper end if the volume is heavier than expected or you are also building it out in QuickBooks. 25% at start, 25% at checkpoint and remainder 50% on delivery of a reconciled set of books.



Option B — Hourly: Propose your per hour fee with a not-to-exceed cap You propose the cap based on your review of scope. We will not approve overages without a written explanation in advance.



Ongoing (optional, after catch-up): Flat fee or hr: TBD - Monthly close by the 10th of the following month: import, categorize, reconcile, update the job and payroll logs, confirm the data-quality check is clean, and send a one-paragraph summary of what the month did. Scoped and priced once we know actual transaction volume.



How to apply



Send: 



Subject line: Reconciliation Showcase_ NAME



A short note on your cleanup experience — specifically, the last set of books you reconstructed. How many months behind, what shape the source data was in, how long it took.

Your preferred structure (flat or hourly) and your number.

Your earliest start date. A short introduction and a little about yourself. 



Two questions you would want answered before quoting this firmly. We weigh this heavily — the questions tell us more than the resume does.



Please do not send a generic bookkeeping services brochure.

Topics include IT governance, cybersecurity, regulation and IT management, such as DORA, NIS2, EU AI Act, Cyber Resilience Act (CRA), ITIL5, PRINCE2 Agile, ISO 27001 / ISMS, IT-Grundschutz, Third Party Risk Management (TPRM) and Business Continuity Management (BCM).



The books are already published on Amazon KDP. I do NOT need book writing, publishing, formatting, cover design or generic social media promotion.



The main focus is measurable Amazon Ads / PPC performance.



TASKS



- Set up and optimize Amazon Sponsored Products campaigns

- Automatic campaigns for keyword/search-term discovery

- Manual keyword campaigns (Exact, Phrase and Broad where appropriate)

- Product / competitor ASIN targeting

- Keyword and competitor research

- Search-term analysis

- Negative keyword management

- Bid and budget optimization

- Monitor ACoS, CPC, CTR, conversion and attributed sales

- Identify profitable keywords and ASIN targets

- Reduce or pause underperforming targets

- Move successful search terms into optimized manual campaigns

- Provide a short and clear performance report



INITIAL PROJECT



We will initially focus on 5 books:



1. ITIL5

2. EU AI Act

3. NIS2

4. DORA

5. Cyber Resilience Act (CRA)



If the campaigns perform well, additional books from the portfolio will be added.



The initial Amazon advertising budget will be approximately EUR 200–300 per month and will be paid directly through my Amazon Ads account.



You do not need to speak German. I can provide the core German terminology and keywords. However, you must be comfortable researching and working with German search terms.



IMPORTANT



I am looking specifically for Amazon PPC / Amazon Ads expertise, preferably with KDP or books.



I am NOT looking for:

- generic social media marketing

- book trailers

- press releases

- purchased or manipulated reviews

- artificial sales or ranking manipulation

- generic "book promotion packages"



The Amazon Ads account and advertising spend remain under my ownership. Access will be limited to what is necessary for campaign management.



EXPECTED WORKLOAD



Initial setup: approximately 15–20 hours.

After setup: approximately 2–3 hours per week on average.



This is intended to become a long-term cooperation if the results are good.



WHEN APPLYING, PLEASE ANSWER:



1. What is your hourly rate or preferred monthly fee?

2. How much Amazon PPC experience do you have?

3. Have you managed Amazon Ads specifically for books / KDP before?

4. Which metrics do you use to evaluate PPC performance?

5. How would you structure campaigns for a newly published nonfiction book?

6. How do you use search-term reports and negative keywords?

7. Do you have experience with competitor / ASIN targeting?

8. Can you provide an anonymized example or screenshot of previous Amazon Ads results?



Please start your application with the words "KDP PPC" so I know you have read the complete job description.



Shortlisted applicants may be offered a small PAID trial task before we start.



Please do not send a generic application. I am looking for someone who can demonstrate practical Amazon PPC knowledge and is interested in a cost-efficient, long-term cooperation.

title: BILINGUAL ENGLISH/SPANISH SHORT-FORM VIDEO EDITOR & CONTENT PRODUCTION SPECIALIST
description:
Long-Term Remote Position | Personal Brand + Real Estate + Lifestyle



I am looking for a talented, creative, reliable short-form video editor and social media content creator to become a long-term member of my growing business and personal-brand team.



I am building a personal brand around Johanna, with content focused on real estate, investing, entrepreneurship, lifestyle, hospitality, travel, homes, products, and building a successful and independent life.



I have 10,000+ photos and videos currently on my phone that can be turned into months of social media content. I also continue to record new content regularly.



I am looking for someone who can take my raw footage and transform it into beautiful, engaging, strategic short-form videos while preserving my personality and natural voice.



ABOUT THE BRAND



My primary personal brand is Johanna.



My content will include:



* Real estate

* Real estate investing

* Entrepreneurship

* Airbnb/hospitality

* Homes and home design

* Lifestyle

* Travel

* Food

* Products and finds

* Behind-the-scenes content

* Personal growth

* Building financial independence

* Educational and inspirational content



I also have connected businesses/brands, including Suite Dreams Cleveland and Pura Vida Finds by Johanna.



The goal is to create a cohesive personal brand while allowing each business to have its own purpose.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



Your primary responsibility will be turning my raw footage into polished short-form content for:



* Instagram Reels

* TikTok

* YouTube Shorts

*
 Reels



You will edit:



* Talking-to-camera videos

* Voiceover videos

* B-roll/storytelling videos

* Real estate educational content

* Property/home tours

* Airbnb/hospitality content

* Travel videos

* Lifestyle content

* Product videos

* Before-and-after videos

* Behind-the-scenes footage

* Inspirational and educational content



I will gradually provide organized batches of footage for editing. You will NOT be responsible for organizing all 10,000+ videos.



You should, however, be comfortable working with Google Drive and clearly labeled folders.



VOICEOVER & STORYTELLING



Voiceover content will be a major part of the brand.



I may provide:



* Raw B-roll

* A voice recording

* A rough idea

* A topic

* Several unrelated clips that you need to turn into a story



You should be able to determine how to combine the footage and voiceover into an engaging video.



For example, I may send footage from an Airbnb renovation and a voice recording explaining what happened.



You should be able to:



* Select the strongest clips

* Create an engaging opening

* Match B-roll to what I am saying

* Remove unnecessary pauses

* Create a natural flow

* Add captions

* Add appropriate music

* Add tasteful text

* End with an appropriate CTA



The finished video should feel like a story, not simply a collection of clips.



TALKING-TO-CAMERA CONTENT



I enjoy talking on camera, but English is my second language.



I have an accent and sometimes make grammatical/conjugation mistakes.



I do NOT want my natural personality or voice erased.



You should be able to clean up obvious mistakes when appropriate, remove awkward pauses, and make the video flow better while keeping me sounding like myself.



I want my audience to connect with Johanna, not a perfectly scripted/artificial version of me.



BILINGUAL REQUIREMENT



English and Spanish are required.



I create content in both languages and sometimes mix English and Spanish in the same video.



You must be comfortable understanding both languages well enough to:



* Understand the meaning of the video

* Select the strongest clips

* Create accurate captions

* Understand bilingual conversations

* Recognize when something is being said in Spanish

* Preserve the meaning and personality of the content



You should be able to tell me honestly if you don’t understand a particular phrase rather than guessing.



Please specify your English and Spanish proficiency when applying.



EDITING STYLE



I am looking for someone with excellent visual taste.



My brand direction is:



* Elegant

* Feminine

* Warm

* Sophisticated

* Joyful

* Aspirational

* Approachable

* Clean

* Editorial

* Organic

* Occasionally colorful and playful



I love beautiful visuals, pastels, earthy colors, feminine details, and occasional bright colors, sparkle, and fun.



I do not want every video to look like a generic TikTok template.



Please avoid excessive:



* Transitions

* Flashing effects

* Emojis

* Zooms

* Sound effects

* Distracting animations

* Cheap-looking templates

* Overly trendy effects that don’t fit the content



The editing should enhance the story and personality rather than overpower it.



CAPTIONS



Captions are extremely important.



You should be able to create:



* Accurate English captions

* Accurate Spanish captions

* Bilingual captions when appropriate

* Proper punctuation

* Easy-to-read captions

* Emphasis on important words



Captions should look polished and fit the brand aesthetic.



HOOKS & RETENTION



You should understand what makes people stop scrolling.



You should be able to recognize when a video needs a stronger opening and suggest a hook.



For example, instead of:



“Today I’m going to show you this property…”



You might suggest:



“I almost walked away from this investment…”



or:



“Three things I wish I knew before buying my first investment property.”



You do not have to write every script, but you must understand short-form storytelling and audience retention.



CONTENT REPURPOSING



I want to create content efficiently.



One piece of footage may be turned into content for:



* Instagram

* TikTok

*

* YouTube Shorts



You should understand how to adapt content for different platforms while maintaining the appropriate format.



SOCIAL MEDIA KNOWLEDGE



You should understand:



* Instagram Reels

* TikTok

* YouTube Shorts

*
 Reels

* Hooks

* Retention

* Captions

* Trending formats

* Music/audio

* CTAs

* Cover images

* Short-form storytelling

* Content repurposing



You do not need to be my full social media manager.



However, I want someone who understands social media well enough to make intelligent suggestions.



If you see an opportunity to improve a video, I want you to tell me.



CANVA



Canva experience is strongly preferred.



You may occasionally help create:



* Reel covers

* TikTok covers

* Simple graphics

* Text overlays

* Branded content



You don’t need to be a professional graphic designer. The primary role is video editing and content creation.



CONTENT VOLUME



Initially, I am looking for approximately:



30-50 short-form videos per month, depending on complexity.



Quality is more important than simply producing a large number of videos.



As the brand grows, the volume and responsibilities may increase.



MY IDEAL EDITOR



I am looking for someone who is:



? Creative

? Reliable

? Organized

? Detail-oriented

? Responsive

? Excellent at short-form editing

? Fluent in English

? Fluent or highly proficient in Spanish

? Good at storytelling

? Comfortable working independently

? Comfortable receiving feedback

? Able to meet deadlines

? Interested in a long-term relationship

? Able to make creative suggestions



I do not want someone who simply waits for me to give extremely detailed instructions.



I want someone who can say:



“I think this footage could make a great Reel. Here’s how I would approach it.”



EXPERIENCE



Please provide examples of:



* Instagram Reels

* TikToks

* YouTube Shorts

* Talking-head videos

* Voiceover videos

* B-roll/storytelling videos



Experience with any of the following is a strong advantage:



* Personal brands

* Real estate

* Real estate investing

* Lifestyle

* Hospitality/Airbnb

* Travel

* Home/design

* Product content



SOFTWARE



Please tell me which software you use.



Examples include:



* CapCut

* Adobe Premiere Pro

* Final Cut Pro

* DaVinci Resolve

* Canva

* Other professional editing software



You do not need to use a specific program as long as your work is excellent.



AVAILABILITY



This is a remote position.



Please provide:



* Your country/city

* Your time zone

* Your normal working hours

* Your availability per week

* Your typical response time during working hours



Some overlap with U.S. Eastern Time is preferred so that communication and feedback are easier.



COMPENSATION



Starting budget:



$300–$500 USD per month



The exact amount will depend on experience, portfolio, availability, quality, and overall fit.



I am looking for the right person, not simply the cheapest person.



This is intended to become a long-term working relationship. As the brand grows and responsibilities/output increase, compensation can be revisited.



PAID TRIAL PROJECT



Before making a long-term decision, selected candidates will complete a paid trial editing project using sample footage.



The trial will allow both of us to determine whether we are a good fit.



I will evaluate:



* Editing quality

* Storytelling

* Hook

* Pacing

* Captions

* English/Spanish accuracy

* Visual taste

* Creativity

* Attention to detail

* Ability to follow direction

* Communication

* Turnaround time



HOW TO APPLY



Please do not send only “Hi, I’m interested.”



To be considered, please answer ALL of the following:



1. PORTFOLIO



Send links to your best short-form video work.



Please provide 3–5 examples.



Include examples of talking-head, voiceover, or storytelling videos if possible.



2. ENGLISH & SPANISH



Tell me your level of:



English:

Native / Fluent / Advanced / Conversational



Spanish:

Native / Fluent / Advanced / Conversational



Please explain whether you can understand and write both languages.



3. EXPERIENCE



How many years have you been editing short-form video?



4. SOFTWARE



What editing software do you use?



5. AVAILABILITY



How many hours per week are you available?



6. MONTHLY RATE



What monthly rate are you requesting for this position?



7. TURNAROUND



How long would you normally need to complete a high-quality 30–60 second Reel?



8. PERSONAL BRAND



Tell me about one personal brand/creator whose content you think is exceptionally well done and WHY.



I want to understand your eye for content, not just your technical editing skills.



9. CREATIVE THINKING



If I give you 10 raw clips from a property, but there is no obvious story, how would you turn them into an engaging Reel?



10. FEEDBACK



How do you normally handle revisions or changes from a client?



11. LONG-TERM WORK



Are you looking for a long-term position or primarily short-term freelance projects?



12. SECRET APPLICATION QUESTION



Start your application with:



“Johanna, let’s build it.”



This tells me that you read the complete job description.



Applications that do not follow the instructions may not be considered.



IMPORTANT



I am looking for someone who wants to grow with a brand, not someone looking for a quick one-time project.



I have a large amount of existing content and many ideas, and I am ready to build a consistent social-media presence.



If you are creative, bilingual, organized, passionate about storytelling, have excellent editing skills, and are excited about helping build something from the ground up, I would love to hear from you.



Thank you!

Johanna

title: HubSpot Sales, Outreach & Reporting Specialist
description:
About the Role



We are looking for a highly experienced HubSpot specialist who knows how to turn HubSpot into a simple, effective system for generating new business, managing sales activity, and giving leadership clear visibility into performance.



We are not looking for someone who simply knows how to navigate HubSpot.



We want someone who understands sales, client outreach, CRM strategy, automation, data, and reporting, and knows how to bring all of those pieces together inside HubSpot.



You should be comfortable coming into an existing HubSpot environment, understanding how the company operates, identifying what is working and what is not, cleaning up the system, and building a better way forward.



What You’ll Be Responsible For



1. HubSpot Reporting & Dashboards



This is one of the most important parts of the role.



You should be excellent at taking data that already exists inside HubSpot and turning it into simple, useful reports and dashboards that leaders and sales teams can actually understand and use.



You will:



* Build custom HubSpot reports and dashboards

* Understand what leadership is trying to measure and determine the best way to report it

* Create sales activity and productivity dashboards

* Track leads, opportunities, pipeline, conversion rates, meetings, proposals, wins, and other KPIs

* Build reports by salesperson, team, market, account, campaign, and time period

* Create executive-level dashboards that make complicated data simple

* Identify gaps or inconsistencies in HubSpot data

* Recommend improvements to properties, fields, pipelines, lifecycle stages, and data structure

* Help ensure the data going into HubSpot is accurate enough to produce meaningful reporting



The goal is not to create more reports. The goal is to create the right reports that help people make better decisions.



2. Sales Outreach & Lead Generation



You will help us use HubSpot as a true outbound sales and business development platform.



You should know how to:



* Build and manage
 sequences

* Create thoughtful multi-touch outreach campaigns

* Personalize outreach at scale

* Build follow-up strategies for prospects

* Segment contacts and companies into targeted lists

* Create automated workflows based on prospect behavior

* Manage lead status and lifecycle stages

* Create tasks and follow-up processes for salespeople

* Improve engagement, response rates, meetings booked, and conversions

* Test and improve outreach strategies over time



You should understand the difference between simply sending
s and creating outreach that actually gets people to respond.



3.
 Marketing & Newsletters



You should have experience using HubSpot’s marketing tools to:



* Build and send newsletters

* Create segmented
 campaigns

* Manage lists and audiences

* Build

* Test subject lines, messaging, timing, and audiences

* Maintain good
 deliverability and database health



4. HubSpot Optimization & Administration



You will also help us continuously improve how HubSpot is structured and used.



This may include:



* Auditing existing HubSpot portals

* Cleaning and organizing CRM data

* Creating custom properties

* Building workflows and automations

* Creating and managing lists

* Managing pipelines and deal stages

* Creating forms and lead capture processes

* Identifying duplicate or incomplete records

* Improving CRM organization

* Connecting HubSpot with other sales and marketing tools

* Training tea
mbers on how to use the system correctly

* Documenting processes and best practices



What We’re Looking For



You should have significant hands-on HubSpot experience and be able to show us examples of systems, reports, dashboards, sequences, or workflows you have personally built.



Strong candidates will have experience with:



* HubSpot Sales Hub

* HubSpot Marketing Hub

* HubSpot CRM

* Custom reporting

* Custom dashboards

* Sequences

* Workflows and automation

*
 marketing

* Newsletters

* Lists and segmentation

* Lead management

* Pipeline management

* CRM data organization

* Sales analytics

* Data cleanup and optimization



HubSpot certifications are a plus, but real-world experience matters more to us than certifications.



What Success Looks Like



We want someone who can take a request like:



“I want to understand how productive our sales team is, where our opportunities are coming from, what activities are generating meetings, how opportunities are moving through the pipeline, and which salespeople are performing best.”



And then independently figure out:



1. What data is available

2. What data is missing

3. How HubSpot should be structured

4. What reports need to be created

5. How the dashboard should be organized

6. How to make the final result simple enough that leadership can understand it in a few minutes



We value people who solve problems instead of simply completing tasks.



The Type of Person We’re Looking For

* Detail-oriented

* Analytical

* Curious

* Resourceful

* Proactive

* A strong communicator

* Comfortable working independently

* Able to simplify complicated information

How to Apply

title: Appointment Setter - DTO Representative
description:
Position Overview: As the first point of contact for individuals seeking care, the DTO Representative plays a crucial role in supporting potential patients dealing with chronic and painful conditions. Your role is pivotal in creating a positive and empathetic first impression while guiding leads toward potentially life-changing treatments. The ideal candidate is a compassionate advocate, skilled at delivering exceptional service and committed to following procedures that enhance the overall patient experience.



Key Responsibilities:



- Patient Advocacy & Lead Ownership: Understand that each lead represents a person in need. Actively listen, troubleshoot, and take ownership of every lead to ensure they receive the guidance they need toward treatment.



- Inbound & Outbound Communication: Handle all inbound inquiries and proactively reach out to potential patients (POPs) daily. Schedule appointments while ensuring that the patient's "important person" (IP), such as a significant other or key individual in their life, is involved. This person often provides crucial context about the patient's condition and can offer support during the decision-making process for care.



- Customer Service Excellence: Deliver outstanding customer service by being patient, friendly, attentive, assertive, and above all, an advocate for every caller. Your goal is to make each person feel heard, valued, and reassured.



- Technology Utilization: Manage communication and scheduling platforms such as Go High Level, Google Calendar, Google Voice, Gmail, and lead tracking sheets with accuracy and efficiency.



- Data Tracking & Accuracy: Diligently review and complete the tracking log for lead engagement, appointments, and outcomes to maintain accountability and ensure no lead falls through the cracks.



- Team Collaboration: Work cohesively with fellow tea
mbers and office staff to ensure a smooth and efficient workflow. Foster a positive and professional environment for everyone involved.



- Create a Fun, Positive Experience: While the work is serious, your attitude doesn’t have to be. Enjoy your role, and let that enjoyment carry over into your interactions, making the experience for everyone as positive as possible.



- Training & Support: We provide comprehensive training to ensure your success in this role. You will be equipped with a detailed video curriculum, including step-by-step Loom videos and documentation, to guide you through handling phone calls and other responsibilities as we expect. title: Part-Time Cold Caller & Onboarding Specialist — Property Acquisition (Australian Real Estate)
description:
Hours: ~5 hours/week to start (flexible, with room to grow for the right person)

Schedule: Must overlap with Australian business hours (ACST) for calling — we'll agree set calling windows

Pay: Base rate + bonus per property signed and booked (details discussed at interview)

Type: Ongoing, long-term



ABOUT US

We are an Australian digital platform for medium-term furnished rentals. We connect property owners with quality tenants (relocating professionals, corporate and healthcare workers) looking for medium-term stays. We are a platform, not a property manager — we market owners' properties and handle the incoming enquiries, while owners stay in control of viewings and who they accept. We're looking for a confident, well-spoken cold caller who can also qualify and onboard owners onto our platform, to help us grow the number of quality properties we list.



THE ROLE

Your job is to call property owners and landlords in Australia, introduce our platform, work out whether their property is a good fit, and guide the right owners through getting their property listed with us. You own the process from first call to a live listing. Importantly, this is not about signing up as many properties as possible — it's about signing up the RIGHT properties: ones that will actually get booked. You will:

- Make outbound calls to a list of property owners we provide

- Follow a script (which we'll give you and refine together), but sound natural and human, not robotic

- Qualify each property early in the call against three key things:

   1. PRICE — the owner has realistic rent expectations (well-priced properties book; overpriced ones sit empty). Ask what rent they're hoping for and gauge whether it's realistic.

   2. AVAILABILITY — the property is genuinely available to rent soon, not months away or currently tenanted.

   3. VIEWINGS — the owner is willing and able to promptly show the property to interested tenants (an owner who can't do viewings means no bookings).

- Politely move on from owners who aren't a fit — don't waste effort onboarding properties that won't book

- Explain simply what we do and why it benefits the owner: we market their property and handle all the incoming enquiries — the owner only handles viewings and decides who to accept

- Handle basic objections and keep the conversation going

- Guide suitable, interested owners through creating an account and listing their property on our platform, and help them complete it

- Follow up with warm leads by phone and
 until their property is live

- Route detailed questions (pricing specifics, terms) to our team

- Log every call, lead, and outcome in a simple spreadsheet or CRM



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

- Excellent spoken English — clear, confident, and easy to understand on the phone (this is the most important requirement)

- Previous cold calling, telemarketing, appointment setting, or phone sales experience

- Good judgement — able to qualify a lead and tell the difference between a property that will book and one that won't, rather than just signing up everyone

- Comfortable making outbound calls and hearing 'no' — resilience matters

- Friendly, persuasive, and genuinely good at building quick rapport

- Organised and thorough at following up — you chase warm leads until they're across the line, and log everything accurately

- Comfortable guiding a non-technical owner through an online signup process patiently

- Reliable internet and a quiet space to call from with a good headset

- Bonus: experience in real estate, property, or the Australian market



WHAT WE OFFER

- A clear script and full training on what to say, how to qualify owners, and how to onboard them

- Warm-ish lists (real property owners, not random numbers)

- Base pay PLUS a bonus for every property that gets signed, listed, and booked — sourcing quality properties directly earns you more

- Flexible hours and a long-term role that can grow into more hours and responsibility as we scale



HOW TO APPLY

When you apply, please include:

1. A short voice recording (30-60 seconds) introducing yourself in English — this helps us hear your phone voice. You can record on your phone and share a link (Google Drive, Vocaroo, etc.)

2. A brief note on your cold calling / phone sales experience

3. Your available hours in ACST (Australian Central Standard Time)



Applications without a voice recording will not be considered. We're excited to find someone great to grow with us.



To confirm you've read this fully, please start your application with the word 'SUNSHINE'.

title: Virtual Administrative & Operations Assistant
description:
Virtual Administrative & Operations Assistant



Long-Term Position | Procare • Billing • Parent Communication • Connecteam • Digital Systems



Roo’s World After School Care is looking for an exceptional, highly organized Virtual Administrative & Operations Assistant to become a long-term part of our growing team.



We are a rapidly growing after-school and summer care organization serving hundreds of children and families across multiple locations. We need someone who can learn our systems inside and out, take ownership of important administrative responsibilities, and help us create more efficient systems as we continue to grow.



This is NOT a position for someone who simply waits for a daily list of tasks.



We are looking for someone who is proactive, detail-oriented, dependable, tech-savvy, an excellent communicator, and capable of eventually managing their area of responsibility with minimal supervision.



YOUR PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES



Procare Management & Billing



* Learn Procare Child Care Management Software inside and out

* Maintain accurate and current family and child accounts

* Manage weekly billing and review accounts for outstanding balances

* Identify families who are behind on payments and follow our established collection procedures

* Keep enrollment, billing, attendance, and account information accurate

* Generate reports as needed

* Help maintain clean, organized records across multiple program locations



Parent Communication



* Monitor and respond to routine parent questions through approved communication channels

* Send billing reminders and other administrative communications

* Follow established policies when answering questions

* Identify situations that need to be escalated to leadership

* Maintain professional, warm, and timely communication with our families



Attendance & Absence Management



* Track reported absences each day

* Update attendance and transportation-related information in Procare

* Maintain accurate daily records

* Help ensure our leadership and transportation teams have current information



Digital Registration & Enrollment

One of our first major projects will be helping us improve our registration process.



We currently want to move away from unnecessary paperwork and create a streamlined digital registration experience.



You will help us:



* Build a professional digital registration process

* Determine what can be integrated or automated with Procare

* Reduce duplicate data entry

* Organize enrollment documentation

* Create an easier experience for parents

* Develop repeatable processes for future enrollment periods



Connecteam Administration



* Learn and help administer our Connecteam system

* Assist with employee onboarding

* Maintain employee information and required documentation

* Help manage scheduling

* Review timekeeping and timesheets for accuracy

* Follow up on missing information

* Keep onboarding and employee records organized and current



Systems & Process Improvement



* Document recurring processes and create SOPs

* Identify administrative tasks that can be simplified or automated

* Build checklists, templates, trackers, and workflows

* Help us create systems that can continue working as our organization grows



WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR



You may be a great fit if you:



* Have excellent written English

* Are extremely organized and detail-oriented

* Learn new software quickly

* Are comfortable working with billing and financial information

* Have experience with administrative systems, CRM/database software, childcare software, HR platforms, or similar technology

* Understand the importance of confidentiality

* Can follow established policies exactly

* Are comfortable communicating professionally with parents and employees

* Can recognize a problem and work toward a solution without waiting to be told every step

* Double-check your work

* Meet deadlines consistently

* Communicate when you don’t know something rather than guessing

* Want a LONG-TERM position where you can learn the organization and grow with us



Experience with Procare or Connecteam is a major plus, but we will consider an exceptional candidate who demonstrates the ability to learn complex systems quickly.



HOURS



Our organization is located in Arkansas, USA, and operates in the Central Time Zone.



Because this role includes billing, attendance, parent communication, scheduling, and daily operational support, you must be willing to have some working-hour overlap with our U.S. business day.



Exact hours and schedule will be discussed during the interview.



WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE



Within your first few months, our goal is for you to understand our systems well enough that you can confidently manage recurring administrative responsibilities without needing constant direction.



We want to be able to trust that:



? Procare is current

? Billing is accurate

? Past-due accounts are identified

? Absences are recorded

? Parent administrative questions are handled

? Employee onboarding is moving forward

? Connecteam information is current

? Timekeeping is being reviewed

? Registration is organized

? Important issues are brought to leadership’s attention



Most importantly, we want someone who takes ownership of their work.



ABOUT ROO’S WORLD



At Roo’s World, we believe in taking exceptional care of children, families, and the people who work with us. We are growing quickly, and we are intentionally building systems and a team that can grow with us.



For the right person, this is not intended to be a short-term freelance project. We are looking for someone who can become a trusted part of our administrative team.



HOW TO APPLY



Please send:



1. A brief introduction about yourself and why you believe you would be a good fit for this position.

2. Your experience with billing, administrative work, customer/parent communication, employee onboarding, scheduling, or timekeeping.

3. Any experience you have with Procare, Connecteam, childcare management systems, CRMs, HR systems, or similar software.

4. Your available working hours in Philippine Time AND Central Time.

5. Your desired hourly/monthly rate.

6. Your internet speed and backup plan if your primary internet or electricity goes down.

7. The computer/equipment you currently use for work.



IMPORTANT: At the very beginning of your application, write the words “READY FOR ROO” so we know you carefully read the entire job posting.



Final Question



Imagine you are responsible for 400+ family accounts and discover that several accounts were not billed correctly while multiple parents are also waiting for responses. Explain, step-by-step, how you would organize the problem, determine what happened, communicate with leadership, correct the accounts, and respond to the families.



We care much more about your thought process than giving us a “perfect” answer.



We are excited to find an amazing human who wants to learn, grow, take ownership, and become an important part of the Roo’s World team!

title: BOOKKEEPER/ BUSINESS MANAGEMENT STAFF
description:
## POSITION OVERVIEW



We are seeking a detail-oriented and organized Business Management / Bookkeeping Staff member to provide day-to-day accounting and administrative support for one of our key clients. This position will work closely with the client and our accounting team to manage accounts payable, accounts receivable, payroll, commission reporting, financial records, and other business management responsibilities.



The ideal candidate is highly organized, responsive, able to manage multiple priorities, and comfortable communicating directly with clients, vendors, and employees.



## KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



### Accounts Payable & Accounts Receivable



* Manage and maintain accounts payable and accounts receivable.

* Process vendor invoices, payments, and customer receipts.

* Monitor outstanding receivables and follow up on past-due balances.

* Maintain accurate vendor and customer records.

* Assist with cash flow monitoring and payment scheduling.



### Commission Reporting



* Prepare recurring commission reports and calculations.

* Review sales and transaction information for accuracy.

* Coordinate commission payments and resolve discrepancies.

* Maintain supporting documentation for commission calculations.



### Payroll



* Coordinate and process payroll information.

* Review payroll reports for accuracy.

* Maintain employee payroll records and assist with payroll-related questions.

* Coordinate with the payroll provider and accounting team as needed.



### Client Support



* Serve as a primary day-to-day contact for the client regarding accounting and business management matters.

* Respond to client questions and requests in a timely and professional manner.

* Coordinate with vendors, employees, and other third parties on behalf of the client.

* Identify issues and communicate them to the appropriate accounting or management team.



### Bookkeeping & Financial Administration



* Perform bank and credit card reconciliations.

* Maintain accurate and organized accounting records.

* Assist with monthly financial reporting and account analysis.

* Enter and review transactions in QuickBooks Online.

* Assist with budgeting, cash flow tracking, and other financial analysis as needed.



### General Business Management Support



* Handle miscellaneous accounting, business management, and administrative tasks related to the client's business.

* Assist with special projects and financial research.

* Maintain organized electronic records and supporting documentation.

* Coordinate with the tax and accounting teams regarding tax filings, information requests, and year-end matters.

* Take on additional responsibilities as needed to support the client's business operations.



## QUALIFICATIONS & REQUIREMENTS



* Minimum 2 years of experience working with U.S.-based clients or accounts.

* 2+ years of bookkeeping, accounting, business management, or related experience.

* Strong understanding of accounts payable and accounts receivable.

* Experience with payroll and commission calculations preferred.

* QuickBooks Online experience preferred.

* Strong Excel/Google Sheets skills.

* Excellent attention to detail and organization.

* Strong written and verbal communication skills.

* Ability to work independently and manage competing priorities.

* Ability to maintain confidentiality when handling sensitive financial and payroll information.

* Strong client service and communication skills.



## IDEAL CANDIDATE



The ideal candidate is someone who can become familiar with the client's business and serve as a reliable day-to-day financial resource. This person should be proactive, dependable, detail-oriented, and comfortable taking ownership of responsibilities.



## WHAT TO EXPECT



As a member of our team, you can expect:



* A welcoming and inclusive environment where your opinions and ideas are valued.

* Opportunities for personal and professional growth through ongoing training and development.

* Competitive compensation and benefits to support you and your family.

* Flexibility to achieve a work-life balance that suits your needs.

* An atmosphere that encourages innovation, creativity, and collaboration.

* Regular team-building activities and social events to unwind and build lasting relationships with your colleagues.



## WORK SCHEDULE



**Monday through Friday, 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM Pacific Time (California time)**



## WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU?



* Competitive salary, depending on experience

* 24 PTO credits

* Remote opportunity — work from the comfort of your home

* Long-term opportunity with career growth and advancement



## OUR BACKGROUND



We are a **U.S.-based accounting firm** committed to providing exceptional service and value to our clients. We believe our success starts with a strong, qualified team and a supportive company culture.



We value teamwork, professional growth, and a positive attitude. Our core belief is that **attitude is just as important, if not more important, than technical skills**, and we strive to create an environment where our tea
mbers feel valued, supported, and empowered to grow.

title: Video Editor, Client SOP Videos
description:
The Role

You'll turn our clients' raw workflow recordings and interviews into clean, clear SOP (Standard Operating Procedure) videos, quickly and accurately, so their teams can train, transition, and document with confidence and so a key step in our client delivery serves as a competitive advantage and client experience enhancement, not a bottleneck.



Why This Matters

These videos are one part of a larger SOP package we deliver to clients. The editing isn't about flashy effects nor is it something that a typical AI workflow software solves. It's about human judgment and clear thinking: watching the content, understanding it, and shaping it so it's concise, complete, and easy to learn from. 

This also makes communication and responsiveness as important as the editing itself. We're looking for someone who seeks to understand the material, asks good questions, gives and takes feedback, and stays in close contact with the team as work moves.

When we do this well, our clients get "the wonderful SOPs you built," creating opportunities for them to hire and scale, and our internal process runs better and adds marketability to our firm. You'll be a real contributor to that result.



What You'll Do

• Edit raw SOP, screen-recording and interview-style videos. Remove gaps and dead time, tighten for conciseness without losing meaning, and clean up loading delays or "spinning wheel" moments.

• Find the natural breakpoints. Listen to the content and cut it into coherent, standalone segments that make sense for training and consumption, almost like course modules.

• Protect confidentiality. Watch for sensitive or client information in the background and handle it according to our standards.

• Keep files and workflow organized to company conventions, so what we need is easy to find and hand off.

• Deliver a rough cut before final clips. One continuous file, dead time and filler out, layout set, breakpoints thoughtfully marked. We confirm or adjust, then you cut to that.

• Stay responsive and communicate as work moves. Post updates, questions, and decisions in provided tools, and flag delays or difficulties early so nothing stalls silently. 

• Join a short weekly check-in and contribute to planning and team discussions. Raise concerns about timing or quality and suggest improvements both upstream (e.g. how we create better raw video) and downstream (e.g. ensuring the usefulness and coherence of all SOP deliverables).

• Over time, and depending on fit and capacity, help with first-pass SOP drafts from transcripts using AI tools, and occasionally other short-form or long-form content.



Who We're Looking For

• A strong communicator who understands the material and the requirements, asks questions rather than guessing, and gives and receives feedback well.

• A team participant who stays responsive, keeps the team updated, and works as part of the process rather than going quiet and delivering in isolation.

• Solid technical video editing skill, with a portfolio you can share.

• The judgment to edit for meaning: finding breakpoints and shaping content for comprehension, not only trimming clips.

• Strong written and spoken English, and the confidence to work through technical material from different sources and different communication styles.

• Integrity and care with sensitive or confidential information.

• Organized and reliable with files, workflow, and turnaround.

• A collaborator who improves a process from within and cares about the end result for the client.



Nice To Have

• Experience with training, course, or SOP-style content.

• Comfort using AI and transcript tools in a content workflow.

• Short-form or long-form video editing.

• Familiarity with US business context, or the appetite to learn it.



Logistics

• Remote and mostly async. The only fixed overlap is one weekly team meeting in the morning, US Central Time. You manage your own schedule around reliable, predictable turnaround and staying reachable during the work week.

• Capacity & Structure: Retainer, not project-by-project. Guaranteed minimum units per month, overflow rate above that.  One unit is up to 60 minutes of source footage, in 60-minute increments. Measured on the raw file we send, confirmed at handoff, never at invoice.

• Volume: Roughly 10-12 units per month, plus a standing backlog. There's always work available.

• Delivery & Turnaround. Rough cut within 48 hours (2 business days) of the cut sheet and raw file. One continuous file, dead time and filler out, layout set, breakpoints marked. We confirm or adjust, then you cut to that. Final clips within 48 hours (2 business days) of our feedback. Both clocks start when we hand off, so our delays are never on you.

• Confidentiality. Live client business data. NDA before any footage moves. Work stays in the accounts we provide, nothing on personal drives. 

• Dedicated setup required: your own computer and stable internet plus the ability to keep our clients' confidential material protected.

• Start date: aiming for on or before August 31, ready to edit from day one.

• Compensation. $500-$1,000 monthly retainer for 12 guaranteed units, plus overflow. Include your rate or a rate range in your application.



Where This Can Lead

This seat sits within our client fulfillment process. The right person grows from part-time to full-time video editor and ultimately into a process contributor, shaping how we build SOPs and, over time, helping us do more content and AV work related to our own processes and thought leadership.



How To Apply

Send a short note (not a template) and tell me why this role interests you.  Also include a link to your portfolio. So I know you read this, start your message with the word "SOP." Strong candidates will be asked to complete a short, paid editing test before any hire.

title: Instagram Content Editor / Creative Content Assistant
description:
# Instagram Content Editor / Creative Content Assistant



**Remote | Part-time | Ongoing**



### We’re looking for someone with an eye ????



Jivita is an Australian wellness brand that does things a little differently.



We’re educational, cheeky, curious and occasionally provocative. We love beautiful design, but we DON'T want content that looks overly polished, corporate, templated or like every other wellness brand on Instagram.



We’re looking for a talented **Instagram Content Editor / Creative Content Assistant** who can take our ideas, raw videos, photos and information and turn them into content people actually want to stop and look at.



Think:



* Beautiful, scroll-stopping Instagram Reels

* Editorial-style carousels

* Vintage / old-world wellness imagery

* Cut-outs, collage, texture and interesting typography

* Educational content that doesn't feel boring

* Strong hooks and visual storytelling

* Content with personality



Our visual world is somewhere between **old-school natural health journal, beautiful editorial magazine, cheeky wellness friend and modern Instagram**.



### What you'll be doing



You’ll work with Kirsty, the founder of Jivita, to turn raw ideas and content into finished Instagram posts.



This may include:



* Editing raw videos into engaging Reels

* Adding captions, hooks, transitions, B-roll and music

* Creating Instagram carousels and still posts

* Taking rough ideas/notes and turning them into visually strong content

* Sourcing appropriate imagery and visual elements

* Repurposing existing content

* Making revisions based on feedback

* Helping maintain a consistent Jivita visual identity



You don't need to be our strategist, copywriter, community manager and personal assistant all rolled into one.



**We mainly want someone who is GREAT at making content.**



### You might be our person if...



You have excellent visual taste.



You understand that "clean design" doesn't mean everything needs to be beige.



You can look at reference images and understand the *feeling* we're trying to create rather than simply copying them.



You know your way around tools such as:



**Canva • CapCut • Adobe Premiere Pro • After Effects • Photoshop**



You don't need to use all of them — we're much more interested in the finished result.



You understand Instagram pacing, hooks and retention.



You're comfortable receiving feedback and trying something again.



You're reliable, communicate well and can meet agreed deadlines.



And importantly...



**You have ideas of your own.**



We don't want someone waiting for instructions on every font size and transition. We'd love someone who eventually understands the Jivita world well enough to say:



*"I saw this and thought it would be perfect for Jivita."*



### How to apply



Please DON'T send us a giant generic cover letter.



Instead, send:



1. A short introduction about yourself.

2. Your portfolio or 5 examples of Instagram content you've personally edited/designed.

3. Tell us which programs you use.

4. Tell us your hourly rate OR preferred monthly arrangement.

5. Tell us how many hours per week you're currently available.

6. Tell us your location/time zone.



And finally:



**Show us one Instagram account whose content you think is visually brilliant and tell us WHY you like it.**



There is no "correct" answer.



We want to see how you think.



### The next step



We'll shortlist a small number of applicants and offer them the **same paid creative test**.



We're looking for someone we'd love to work with long-term, so we're happy to invest a little time finding the right person.



If you have great creative instincts, love wellness and enjoy making content that doesn't look like everyone else's...



**We'd love to see your work.**

* Design high-quality website layouts and user experiences using Figma or similar software

* Develop logos and complete brand identity kits

* Design social media posts and campaign graphics

* Create Meta advertising creatives designed to capture attention and drive conversions

* Follow existing brand guidelines while maintaining consistency across all materials

* Manage multiple client projects and priorities simultaneously

* Complete revisions efficiently and meet agreed deadlines

* Work collaboratively with our development and marketing teams



What We’re Looking For

* At least 3 years of professional graphic and UX design experience

* Previous experience working for a digital, marketing or creative agency

We value designers who can think independently, communicate clearly and bring creative ideas to the table. We are looking for someone dependable who takes ownership of their work and consistently delivers polished designs.

Editor & Social Media Assistant | Go Button Content



Location: Remote (Philippines-based preferred)

Hours: 40 hrs/week

Pay: AUD $800–$1,200/month + 13th month, based on experience

Start: Immediate.



Closing date for submission 8TH SEPTEMBER 2026





Who we are



Go Button Content is a Sydney-based video production, animation and photography studio. We make documentary-style, training, safety, and corporate content for organisations doing complex, essential work, mining, construction, oil and gas, local government, healthcare, etc.



We make informative content that audiences get value from and people actually want to watch. Often that is real stories about real people doing real work. We care about making a positive impact.





About the role



We're looking for someone to join us as an Editor & Social Media Assistant. This is a hands-on editing role focused on craft, plus running social content for us.



What you'll be doing:



Editing raw footage into polished deliverables.

Editing raw footage into social media cutdowns, drafts, and finished pieces

Organising and labelling interview footage using our editing method (training provided)

Preparing videos and graphics for review before they reach our director

Scheduling approved social media content.

General production admin: file organisation, status updates

Updating social media channels.



This is not a client-facing or project management role. Once you've built a strong track record with us, there's an option to start sending finished edits directly to a client and receiving their notes back, but that's several months out, and it stays a narrow exchange, not broader account management.



Who we're looking for:



Strong written and spoken English

Confident in Adobe Premiere Pro (Photoshop and After Effects a bonus)

Comfortable with Dropbox

Genuinely interested in storytelling, able to spot a theme in raw footage, not just cut where you're told

Organised, reliable, good attention to detail

Able to work within Australian Eastern time zone for a defined overlap window



To apply



Please include:

A short cover note, and tell us about a documentary, feature film or short film that stuck with you, and why. (We read every application properly, and this tells us you did too.)

Examples of your edit work, ideally something documentary or interview-style

A screenshot of your current internet speed



Timeline:



2 weeks after submissions close 1st round short list will be given a short zoom interview.

2 weeks after first interviews, 2nd round shortlisted applicants will be given a 2nd interview & will be given a small paid test project before any ongoing commitment.

2 weeks after the paid test project, final decisions will be made.



Paid Editing Test Task:

You will be given footage to download and 4 hours to cut a 2-3 min documentary edit. This will be a paid on completion at $50 AUD.



Values:



At Go Button Content we believe in loyalty, kindness and professionalism. We will always be upfront and honest and look after our teammembers and we expect the same in return. We believe in helping each other grow and develop and we believe that feedback is the key to that.



We pay on time, every time, and we're building this for the long term, if you're looking for stability rather than a short gig, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Digital Marketing Agency Assistant
description:
Website QA, Client Communication & Project Coordination





We are a web design and digital marketing agency looking for an experienced Digital Marketing Agency Assistant to support website quality assurance, client communication, project coordination, and agency administration.



This role works closely with our clients and specialist teams to keep projects organized, ensure work meets our standards, and help clients clearly understand what is being done and why it matters.



A major part of the role involves reviewing and polishing websites before client delivery. You should be comfortable working in Webflow, Framer, GoHighLevel, and WordPress, identifying issues, and making standard content, formatting, and layout corrections when needed. If there are a large number of changes or technical changes, you should document the updates and send them to the team for revision.



You will not be responsible for executing specialist marketing services for client work. Our SEO, advertising, web development, and specialist teams handle delivery.

 



Responsibilities

- Manage client onboarding, feedback, approvals, content requests, project updates, and follow-ups

- Prepare proposals to send to potential clients

- Communicate professionally with clients and explain our web design, SEO, digital marketing, advertising, workflow, and automation services

- Help clients understand what work is being completed, why it matters, and what they need to do next

- Coordinate projects, deadlines, deliverables, and revisions between clients and specialist teams

- Maintain project management systems, CRM records, client files, checklists, and general agency administration

- Follow up with clients and team members on outstanding tasks and escalate issues when needed

- Review marketing deliverables for completeness, accuracy, and presentation before client delivery

- Perform detailed website QA across desktop, tablet, and mobile

- Check layouts, spacing, typography, content, images, links, buttons, forms, navigation, and overall functionality

- Make minor website content, formatting, image, link, and layout updates

- Document larger website issues, coordinate corrections with designers or developers, and verify revisions before client delivery

- Recheck completed revisions before websites are sent to clients

- Identify delays, incomplete work, or client concerns and escalate them to the appropriate person when required

 

Required Skills

- Excellent written and spoken English with strong professional client communication skills

- Ability to understand and explain web design, SEO, digital marketing, and technical concepts to anyone in an easy-to-understand manner

- Strong website QA skills with excellent visual attention to detail and proofreading ability

- Experience with Webflow, Framer, GoHighLevel, and WordPress

- Confidence making minor website content, formatting, and layout changes

- Good understanding of responsive web design and basic website functionality

- A well-rounded understanding of SEO and digital marketing

- Strong organizational and project coordination skills with the ability to manage multiple clients, deadlines, and deliverables

- Experience with project management software, CRM systems, and Google Workspace

- Strong initiative, follow-through, and judgment when deciding what to handle independently and what to send to other team members

 

This is a temp-to-contract position.

title: Short-Form & Long-Form Content Manager — Founder Personal Brand (Remote, Full-Time)
description:
I'm a founder building a community. I host events, run a membership, and want to build a strong personal brand on LinkedIn, Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube.



I'm looking for someone who lives and breathes content — not just an editor, but someone who thinks strategically about what to post, sends me ideas without being asked, writes scripts, and produces content that actually performs.



What you'll do:



Edit 15-20 short-form videos per month (60-90 seconds) for Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube Shorts

Edit 4-6 long-form YouTube videos per month — full edit, thumbnails, chapter markers, descriptions

Clip the best moments from every YouTube video into short-form content automatically — don't wait to be asked

Add captions, transitions, music, and graphics to every video

Write captions and hooks for every post

Research trending audio, formats, and topics in the founder/entrepreneurship space weekly

Send me 5 content ideas every week — what to film, what angle to take, what's performing right now

Build and manage a content calendar

Monitor performance — track what's working and what isn't and tell me

Suggest repurposing opportunities — turn an event clip into 5 posts, a LinkedIn post into a script, etc.

Be my second brain on content — if you see something I should react to or comment on, flag it



Turnaround:



48 hours for short-form

5 days for long-form

Weekly content ideas every Monday morning



What I need from you to apply:



Show me 3 accounts you follow that inspire you and explain why

Send me your 3 best edits (short and long-form)

Complete a paid one-week trial before we commit

title: Sales Manager
description:
ABC Solutions is a fast-growing U.S.-based cleaning company providing high-quality residential and commercial cleaning services across Seattle. We are committed to delivering exceptional customer experiences through professionalism, reliability, and strong operational systems.

Our company operates with structured processes, modern CRM tools, and clear performance standards. We focus on long-term client relationships, consistent service quality, and building a strong, motivated remote team.

As we continue to expand, we are looking for a proactive and detail-oriented Sales Manager who will play a key role in client communication, scheduling coordination, and service sales.



Requirements

1. High level of English (Upper-Intermediate and above).

2. Experience in sales will be an advantage.

3. Ability to work with CRM — we will train you if you don’t have experience.

4. Strong communication skills, responsibility, results-oriented mindset, and ability to work in a team and prioritize tasks.



Key Responsibilities

1. Handling incoming calls and communicating with clients

2. Active sales of cleaning services to American clients

3. Managing clients in CRM systems (booking, updates, statuses)

4. Supporting clients throughout all stages (from inquiry to payment)

5. Assisting with scheduling and coordinating work for cleaning teams

6. Preparing reports based on work performance



What We Offer

1. Fully remote position — work from anywhere in the world.

2. Flexible work format of your choice (allowing you to work from anywhere in the world): part-time (about 15 days per month), ¾ or 4/3 schedule, working hours from 9:00–7:00 AM (PT), or full-time from Monday to Friday, or any other 5 days during the week 9:00–7:00 AM (PT).

3. Stable income potential with performance-based bonuses.

4. Career growth opportunities within an international company.

5. Structured onboarding and mentor support (1-week training period, 1–2 hours per day; training is unpaid).

6. Clear career path to Operations Manager.

7. Work in a growing U.S. company with organized systems and long-term vision.
