title: Product Software Engineer
description:
We are a small Australian outdoor travel company looking for a Product Software Engineer to join our Logistics Team.

This is a full-time, long-term position where you will become an integral part of the company. You will design, build and improve software that supports our operations and customer experience.



We are not hiring for a particular programming language or framework. We want an adaptable engineer who can understand a problem, choose an appropriate technical approach and take a solution through the complete software development lifecycle.



The role



You will:

Translate business problems into practical software solutions.

Design and build applications, systems and integrations.

Select technologies based on the needs of each project.

Take projects from discovery and architecture through development, testing, deployment and maintenance.

Improve existing systems as well as build new products.

Use AI-assisted development workflows to prototype, build and debug efficiently.

Learn how the company operates and progressively take independent ownership of projects.



About you



You should have:

Experience building and shipping complete production applications or systems.

A strong understanding of software architecture and the development lifecycle.

The ability to work across different technologies and learn unfamiliar tools quickly.

Experience turning unclear requirements into structured, maintainable solutions.

Strong testing, debugging and problem-solving skills.

Experience using AI-assisted development workflows responsibly.

Can use AI coding tools effectively while remaining responsible for code quality, testing and maintainability.

Good communication skills and the ability to work effectively with non-technical colleagues.

A focus on outcomes, reliability and long-term maintainability.

We care more about what you have built and how you approach engineering problems than whether you match a fixed technology list.



What you get



Starting monthly salary of AUD 1,150, based on experience, with annual raises and potential bonuses.

Working hours of 9:00 am–5:00 pm Manila time.

13th-month pay.

Paid sick leave.

25 flexible days of paid time off, including holidays.

Fortnightly pay.

No requirement to use TimeProof.



How to apply



Please attach your résumé and submit a short video introduction of one to two minutes covering the following:

Begin the video by saying “Hello Maddie” so we know it was made for this application.

Briefly introduce yourself and your experience building software products.

Describe one application or system you helped take from an idea into production. Explain the problem, what you personally owned and the key technical decisions you made.

Explain how you use AI during development while ensuring the resulting code is correct, tested and maintainable.

Please also include links to any relevant products, portfolios, GitHub repositories or code samples you can share.



Use the following subject line when submitting your application:

[Your name] + [Your favourite AI model]



We look forward to hearing from you!

title: BILINGUAL ENGLISH/SPANISH SHORT-FORM VIDEO EDITOR & CONTENT PRODUCTION SPECIALIST
description:
BILINGUAL ENGLISH/SPANISH SHORT-FORM VIDEO EDITOR & CONTENT PRODUCTION SPECIALIST



Long-Term Remote Position | Personal Brand + Real Estate + Lifestyle



I am looking for a talented, creative, reliable short-form video editor and content production specialist to become a long-term member of my growing media/business team.



This is NOT simply a job where you receive one video and cut it into a Reel.



I am building a personal brand around Johanna and need someone who can help turn a very large library of existing footage into strategic, beautiful, engaging content.



I have 10,000+ photos and videos currently on my phone, including talking-to-camera footage, voiceovers, real estate, Airbnb/hospitality, travel, food, lifestyle, home design, product content, and behind-the-scenes footage.



I need someone who can help me transform this raw content into a consistent content pipeline.



ABOUT THE BRAND



My primary personal brand is Johanna.



The content will cover:



• Real estate

• Real estate investing

• Entrepreneurship

• Airbnb/hospitality

• Homes and home design

• Lifestyle

• Travel

• Food

• Products and finds

• Personal growth

• Building a successful and financially independent life

• Behind-the-scenes content



I also have connected businesses/brands including Suite Dreams Cleveland and Pura Vida Finds by Johanna.



The goal is to create content that feels cohesive while allowing each business to have its own purpose.



WHAT I NEED FROM YOU



You will primarily be responsible for taking my raw footage and turning it into polished short-form content for:



• Instagram Reels

• TikTok

• YouTube Shorts

•
 Reels



Content may eventually be repurposed across additional platforms.



You will edit:



• Talking-head videos

• Voiceover videos

• B-roll/storytelling videos

• Home/property tours

• Real estate educational videos

• Travel videos

• Lifestyle videos

• Product videos

• Airbnb/hospitality content

• Before-and-after content

• Behind-the-scenes content

• Educational and inspirational content



BILINGUAL REQUIREMENT



English and Spanish are required.



I frequently create content in English and Spanish, and some videos may contain both languages.



You must be comfortable understanding spoken Spanish and English well enough to:



• Understand the meaning of the footage

• Select the best clips

• Create accurate captions/subtitles

• Understand bilingual conversations

• Preserve my natural voice and personality

• Know when content should be captioned in English, Spanish, or both



You do NOT need to make my English sound artificially perfect.



My accent and natural way of speaking are part of my identity.



However, you should be able to identify obvious mistakes, confusing sections, awkward pauses, or places where editing can make the message clearer.



WHAT A TYPICAL PROJECT MAY LOOK LIKE



I may give you:



• Several raw video clips

• A voice memo

• A rough idea

• A topic

• A folder of B-roll

• Or simply say, “I want to make a video about this.”



You will help turn that into a finished short-form video.



For example:



I send you footage of an Airbnb renovation plus a voice recording explaining what happened.



You determine:



• Which clips are strongest

• The best opening/hook

• The order of the footage

• Where to cut

• Where B-roll should appear

• Captions

• Music

• On-screen text

• Pacing

• Ending/CTA



The final video should feel intentional—not like random clips placed together.



EDITING STYLE



I am looking for an editor with excellent visual taste.



My brand direction is:



• Elegant

• Feminine

• Warm

• Organic

• Aspirational

• Joyful

• Sophisticated

• Approachable

• Clean

• Editorial

• Pura Vida-inspired



I like beautiful visuals, natural light, soft colors, earthy/pastel tones, feminine details, and occasional fun/colorful moments.



I do NOT want every video to look like a generic TikTok template.



Avoid excessive:



• Transitions

• Flashing effects

• Emojis everywhere

• Overly aggressive zooms

• Distracting animations

• Cheap-looking templates

• Trendy effects that don’t fit the content



The editing should make the content more compelling without overpowering the person speaking.



CAPTIONS



Captions are extremely important.



You should be able to create:



• Accurate English captions

• Accurate Spanish captions

• Bilingual captions when appropriate

• Emphasis on important words

• Easy-to-read formatting

• Correct punctuation



Captions should be visually attractive but never make the video difficult to watch.



HOOKS



You should understand short-form storytelling and retention.



You should be able to recognize when a video needs a stronger opening and suggest a hook.



Examples:



Instead of:



“Today I’m going to show you this house…”



Potentially:



“I almost walked away from this property…”



or:



“Three things I wish I knew before buying an investment property.”



You do not need to write every script yourself, but you should understand what makes someone stop scrolling.



CONTENT SELECTION



Because I have 10,000+ pieces of footage, I need someone who can help identify valuable content.



You should be able to look at raw footage and recognize:



• A good story

• A funny moment

• A useful tip

• A beautiful visual

• A strong emotional moment

• A potential educational video

• A potential trend

• Footage that can be repurposed



I do NOT want someone who simply waits for me to tell them exactly which 30 seconds to edit.



I want a creative partner who can make suggestions.



CONTENT ORGANIZATION



A major part of this position will eventually involve helping organize my large content library.



We will use cloud storage and an organized folder system.



You should be comfortable working with:



• Google Drive

• Cloud-based folders

• File naming systems

• Content categories

• Editing queues

• Approved content

• Posted content



You should be organized enough that we can gradually turn thousands of random videos into a usable content library.



CANVA



Canva experience is strongly preferred.



You may occasionally help with:



• Reel covers

• TikTok covers

• Simple graphics

• Text overlays

• Story graphics

• Branded templates



The primary job is video editing, but familiarity with Canva is a major advantage.



SOCIAL MEDIA KNOWLEDGE



You should understand how content differs between:



• Instagram Reels

• TikTok

• YouTube Shorts

•
 Reels



You should understand:



• Video length

• Hooks

• Retention

• Captions

• Trends

• Audio/music

• Cover images

• CTAs

• Repurposing



You do NOT need to be my complete social media manager at this stage.



However, I want someone who understands the social-media environment and can make intelligent recommendations.



CONTENT VOLUME



I am building a consistent publishing system.



Initially, I expect approximately:



15–30 short-form videos per month, depending on the complexity of the content and the final workflow.



Quality is more important than simply producing a large number of videos.



As the brand grows, the volume and responsibilities may increase.



LONG-TERM OPPORTUNITY



This is intended to be a long-term position, not a one-time project.



If we work well together, I would like this person to become a consistent part of my media team as the brand grows.



There may eventually be opportunities to take on additional responsibilities involving:



• Content strategy

• Content repurposing

• Scheduling

• Social media support

• Trend research

• Analytics

• Content planning



Those responsibilities would be added gradually and compensated accordingly.



WHO I AM LOOKING FOR



You should be:



? Creative

? Reliable

? Organized

? Detail-oriented

? Responsive

? Comfortable working independently

? Good at storytelling

? Excellent at short-form editing

? Fluent in English

? Fluent or highly proficient in Spanish

? Comfortable receiving feedback

? Able to meet deadlines

? Interested in building a long-term working relationship



I especially value someone who can say:



“I noticed this footage could become a great video. Here’s what I would do.”



rather than simply:



“Tell me exactly what to do.”



EXPERIENCE



Please include examples of:



• Instagram Reels

• TikToks

• YouTube Shorts

• Talking-head videos

• Voiceover videos

• Storytelling/B-roll videos



Real estate, lifestyle, hospitality, travel, beauty, home, or personal-brand experience is a strong advantage.



SOFTWARE



Please tell me which programs you use.



Examples:



• CapCut

• Adobe Premiere Pro

• Final Cut Pro

• DaVinci Resolve

• Canva

• Other editing software



You do not need to use a specific program as long as your work is excellent.



TIME ZONE & AVAILABILITY



This is a remote position.



Please tell me:



• Your country/city

• Your time zone

• Your normal working hours

• How many hours per week you are available

• Your response time during working hours



Some overlap with U.S. Eastern Time is preferred because communication and feedback will be easier.



COMPENSATION



Starting budget:



$300–$500 USD per month, depending on experience, portfolio, availability, and scope.



I am looking for the right person rather than simply the cheapest person.



If the relationship works well and responsibilities/output increase, compensation can increase accordingly.



PAID TRIAL PROJECT



Before making a long-term decision, selected candidates will be asked to complete a paid trial editing project using actual sample footage.



The trial will allow both of us to determine whether we are a good fit.



I will evaluate:



• Editing quality

• Storytelling

• Captions

• English/Spanish accuracy

• Pacing

• Creativity

• Attention to detail

• Ability to follow brand direction

• Communication

• Turnaround time



HOW TO APPLY



Please DO NOT send only:



“Hi, I’m interested.”



To be considered, please send all of the following:



1. PORTFOLIO



Send links to your best short-form video work.



Please include at least 3–5 examples.



2. BILINGUAL EXPERIENCE



Tell me your level of English and Spanish.



Please explain whether you are:



• Fluent

• Native

• Conversational

• Reading/writing proficient



3. YOUR EXPERIENCE



Tell me how many years you have been editing short-form content.



4. SOFTWARE



Tell me which editing programs you use.



5. AVAILABILITY



How many hours per week can you commit?



6. MONTHLY RATE



Tell me your desired monthly rate for the responsibilities described above.



7. TURNAROUND



How long would you normally need to complete a 30–60 second Reel?



8. CONTENT LIBRARY



Tell me how you would approach organizing and turning a library of 10,000+ raw videos into an ongoing content pipeline.



9. PERSONAL BRAND



Name one personal brand/creator whose content you think is exceptionally well done and explain WHY.



10. SECRET APPLICATION QUESTION



Start your application with the words:



“Johanna, let’s build it.”



This tells me you read the complete job description.



Applications that do not follow the instructions may not be considered.



IMPORTANT



I am looking for a person who wants to grow with a brand—not someone looking for a quick freelance project.



If you are creative, organized, bilingual, passionate about storytelling, and excited about helping build something from the ground up, I would love to hear from you.



Thank you!



Johanna

title: Full-Time Accounts Payable and Accounts Receivable Assistant
description:
A Canadian warehousing and logistics company is seeking an experienced Accounts Payable and Accounts Receivable Assistant.

The successful applicant will prepare customer invoices, monitor and collect outstanding balances, process supplier invoices, track upcoming payments, and maintain accurate financial records.

This position requires at least one year of accounting-related experience, excellent attention to detail, strong English communication skills, and the ability to handle confidential financial information responsibly.

Accounts Receivable Responsibilities

Prepare and issue accurate customer invoices using Zoho Invoice

Review warehouse records to identify all billable services

Calculate receiving, storage, outbound, fulfillment, labour, packaging, transportation, and other service charges

Compare invoices against approved customer rate sheets

Send invoices and account statements to customers

Track invoice dates, payment terms, due dates, payments, and outstanding balances

Monitor Due on Receipt and Net 15 customer accounts

Follow up on overdue invoices by
 and telephone

Document collection activity, customer responses, payment commitments, and disputes

Match customer payments against outstanding invoices

Investigate billing discrepancies and missing charges

Prepare weekly accounts receivable and collections reports

Escalate disputed or seriously overdue accounts to management

Accounts Payable Responsibilities

Receive, review, and record supplier invoices

Confirm that supplier invoices are accurate and properly supported

Match invoices with purchase approvals, receipts, contracts, or service records

Identify duplicate invoices, incorrect charges, and missing documentation

Maintain a schedule of bills and payment due dates

Prepare supplier invoices for management approval

Prepare proposed weekly payment schedules

Record approved payments in the accounting system

Maintain organized supplier records and supporting documents

Communicate professionally with suppliers regarding invoice discrepancies

Reconcile supplier statements against company records

Track recurring expenses and ensure invoices are received and recorded

Prepare weekly accounts payable and upcoming-payment reports

Escalate urgent, disputed, or unusual supplier charges to management

General Accounting Responsibilities

Maintain accurate accounts payable and accounts receivable records

Update Excel or Google Sheets financial trackers

Assist with bank and credit-card reconciliations

Organize invoices, receipts, rate sheets, statements, and payment records

Assist with month-end reporting and record preparation

Provide management with weekly cash collection and payment summaries

Assist with additional bookkeeping and administrative tasks when required

Required Qualifications

At least one year of professional accounting, bookkeeping, accounts payable, accounts receivable, or billing experience

Practical experience with both accounts payable and accounts receivable

Experience using Zoho Invoice or QuickBooks

title: Senior QBO Accountant - Import/Export & Landed Cost Setup
description: We are an international trading company based specializing in the import and distribution of physical goods. We are looking for an experienced Senior Accountant and Bookkeeper to build our QuickBooks Online Plus architecture completely from scratch and manage our ongoing bookkeeping. This role requires an independent professional capable of establishing complex accounting setups without pre-existing procedures and with a strong understanding of international trade workflows. The selected candidate will be responsible for setting up our Chart of Accounts, project case tracking, and brand class tracking. Key tasks include calculating and allocating air/sea freight, customs duties, and local logistics costs proportionally based on value across specific project items to track real profit margins. You will also manage a specific three-step deferred revenue workflow by recording client prepayments into Unearned Revenue liability accounts tied to paper tax invoice numbers, applying credits to recognize revenue only upon customs clearance and delivery. Additional duties include creating unique project-based inventory items to prevent cost blending, tracking official import declarations and HS codes via custom fields, reconciling monthly bank accounts, managing multi-currency exchange risk, and generating clean profitability reports. Candidates must hold a Bachelor's Degree in Accountancy or equivalent, have proven advanced experience setting up QBO Plus from scratch, and possess a strong background in import export accounting, landed cost calculations, and accrual accounting. To apply, please submit your updated resume along with a brief overview of your experience setting up QBO Plus from scratch and a short explanation of how you handle landed cost allocations.

Sunset Reef is a small luxury boutique resort on the island of St. Kitts in the Caribbean. We offer a limited number of high-end villa-style units with private outdoor living spaces, pool, hot tub, cold plunge, and an elevated guest experience focused on privacy, quality, and personal service. We operate primarily through major OTAs and direct channels and are looking for a sharp, proactive remote team member to take ownership of our online distribution, rate integrity, and booking growth.



Role Overview

You will be responsible for managing all aspects of our online bookings and promotions across major OTAs (Airbnb, Booking.com, VRBO, Expedia, and others), ensuring rates, availability, and content stay perfectly aligned, handling guest payments, coordinating day-pass sales, and driving more high-quality bookings through smart pricing, promotions, and channel optimization. You will work closely with our onsite team (Operations Manager and Rooms Supervisor) and the Owner, primarily using our property management system, WebResPro.



Key Responsibilities

-Daily management of calendars, availability, and bookings across all OTAs and direct channels using WebResPro property management software

-Maintain strict rate parity and alignment across every platform (no undercutting or mismatched rates)

-Process and charge guest credit cards for deposits, balances, incidentals, and other charges through WebResPro and related payment systems

-Manage and coordinate day-pass bookings for cruise ship guests, ensuring seamless integration between day-pass websites, hotel bookings, restaurant reservations, and beach bar operations

Stay current on OTA algorithm changes, new tools, and best practices for Caribbean luxury rentals and day-pass programs



Requirements

-Proven experience managing short-term rental or boutique hotel inventory on major OTAs (Airbnb, Booking.com, VRBO required)

-Experience using (or ability to quickly learn) WebResPro property management software

-Comfortable and accurate handling of guest credit card charges and payment processing

-Strong understanding of dynamic pricing, rate parity, and multi-channel distribution

-Excellent written English and professional communication skills

-Highly organized, detail-oriented, and able to work independently while coordinating effectively with an onsite Operations Manager, Rooms Supervisor, and Owner

-Reliable internet connection and ability to work flexible hours when needed (Caribbean time zone)



Preferred Qualifications

-Prior hands-on experience with PMS sofware

-Experience with luxury or boutique properties that also operate restaurants or beach bars

-Familiarity with other channel managers or property management systems

-Previous success increasing occupancy, revenue, or ancillary sales through promotions and listing optimization

title: Amazon Product Sourcing VA (Keepa & SellerAmp Experience Required)

I currently sell through Amazon FBM and am also preparing to expand into FBA. I am rebuilding and scaling my store, so I am looking for someone who can consistently find quality, realistic sourcing opportunities, not simply fill a spreadsheet with random products.



This position is strictly for product sourcing. You will not be responsible for purchasing inventory, managing my finances, hiring other workers, or making final purchasing decisions. I will review and approve all products before anything is purchased.



You Will:

- Find potential profitable products from approved sourcing methods

- Analyze products using Keepa and SellerAmp

- Check sales history and price stability

- Evaluate competition and number of sellers

- Review BSR/sales rank and sales potential

- Calculate estimated profit and ROI

- Check for price drops and historical pricing

- Identify potential sourcing risks

- Check product restrictions/gating when applicable

- Enter qualified leads into my Google Sheet

- Follow my sourcing criteria and notes

- Communicate clearly about why you believe a product is a good opportunity



Tools you should already be comfortable using:

- Keepa

- SellerAmp

- Amazon Seller Central

- Google Sheets



You do NOT need to provide your own paid Keepa or SellerAmp subscription. I will provide the access necessary for the position.



I am looking for someone who:

- Has previous Amazon product sourcing experience

- Understands how to evaluate profitability beyond simply looking at ROI

- Can read Keepa charts confidently

- Understands Amazon fees and FBA/FBM economics

- Knows how to identify price history and potential sales velocity

- Pays attention to detail

- Can follow specific sourcing criteria

- Is honest when a product does NOT meet the criteria

- Can work independently without constant supervision

- Is willing to improve as my sourcing criteria evolve



***Quality is much more important to me than the number of leads submitted. I would rather receive 10 strong leads than 50 poor-quality leads.***



Hours

10/week to start

Approximately 2 hours per day, Monday–Friday.



The schedule can be discussed, but I need consistent availability and communication during the agreed working hours. If you perform well and consistently provide profitable leads, there may be an opportunity to increase the number of hours.



Pay

$3/hour

**This is a part-time position to start, with the possibility of additional hours based on performance.



To Apply, please answer the following questions in your application:

- How long have you been doing Amazon product sourcing?

- How comfortable are you with Keepa? (1–10)

- How comfortable are you with SellerAmp? (1–10)

- What types of Amazon products/categories have you sourced before?

- Approximately how many qualified leads could you realistically provide during 10 hours of work per week?

title: Bankruptcy Paralegal / Intake Specialist — US Consumer Law Firm (Direct Attorney Access, Not a Call Center)
description:
TIMEZONE:  US Pacific Time



READ THIS FIRST: Start your application with the word PETITION. Applications that skip this aren't read.



WHO WE ARE

Symmes Law Group is a consumer bankruptcy and real estate law firm in Seattle, WA, in practice since 2010. We're intentionally small — you'd work directly with the attorney handling your files, not through layers of case managers at a high-volume shop. Our last VA in this role stayed 2 years and is leaving on good terms for a new opportunity; we're looking to build that kind of long-term relationship again, at a competitive wage.



WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR



A self-starter who doesn't need to be micromanaged to stay on top of deadlines

Genuinely organized — the kind of person who catches a missing document before anyone asks

Someone who actually cares about helping people through financial distress, not just processing files. Our clients are often at a hard point in their lives, and how you talk to them matters as much as how accurately you fill out a schedule.



WHAT YOU'LL DO



Prepare Chapter 7 and Chapter 13 petitions from client intake documents: pull data from credit reports, paystubs, bank statements, and tax returns

Complete schedules, the Statement of Financial Affairs, and the means test worksheet using bankruptcy software (Best Case, NextChapter, Jubilee, or Glade a strong plus)

Spot missing documents and follow up with clients directly

Submit 341 documents to bankruptcy trustees

Answer phones, schedule appointments, handle professional client communication

Draft correspondence and legal documents under attorney guidance

Support debt settlement negotiations and case tracking

Manage matters in Lawmatics (our CRM/practice management system) — updating case status, tasks, and client communication

Cross-train into other practice areas as you grow: purchase and sale transactions, short sales, estate planning, probate — more variety than a pure-BK shop



REQUIRED



At least 1 year preparing US bankruptcy petitions, or 2+ years in a US law firm, mortgage servicing, or similar role handling US financial documents daily

Strong English reading and Communication ability — able to read a tax return or mortgage statement and know what you're looking at and communiate with clients and third parties over the phone and through e-mail. 

Comfortable with Adobe Pro, MS Word, Google Workspace

Reliable internet (25+ Mbps) and backup power



NICE TO HAVE



Experience with Jubilee, Lawmatics, or similar legal CRM/case management software

Debt settlement or debt negotiation experience



WHY STAY



Direct access to the attorney — real mentorship, not a queue

Broader skill set across practice areas, not single-track petition assembly

Proven track record: predecessor was here 2 years

Competitive pay at the top of market for proven skill



TO APPLY

Start your message with PETITION, then answer:



What US bankruptcy or legal document work have you done, and what software have you used?

What's the difference between Schedule I and Schedule J, and what does a negative bottom line on Schedule J mean for a Chapter 13 case?

If you visited the United States as a tourist, what would you most want to see — or if you've been, what was your favorite part?



Attach your resume and your expected monthly wage.

title: elearning instructional designer
description:
**JOB OVERVIEW**



Franchise Education Australia is seeking a skilled and creative **eLearning Developer / Instructional Designer** to help transform professionally written course content into engaging, polished online learning experiences.



Our courses are designed for Australian franchise partners and focus on the practical business skills needed to operate and grow a successful franchise. Topics include financial management, reading financial reports, legal compliance, people management, local area marketing and business planning.



The successful candidate will complete an initial **paid trial involving one full micro-course**. If the trial is successful, there will be an opportunity to support the ongoing development of a larger course library.



**Key Responsibilities:**



• Transform provided course content into structured, engaging and easy-to-follow online learning.



• Apply instructional design principles to improve course flow, learner engagement and knowledge retention.



• Build responsive eLearning courses using **Articulate Rise 360**, with Articulate Storyline used where more advanced interactions are appropriate.



• Create professional graphics, layouts, scenarios, knowledge checks, quizzes and interactive learning activities.



• Source or create suitable icons, imagery and visual elements that align with the Franchise Education Australia brand.



• Complete basic video and audio editing where required.



• Proofread course content and recommend improvements to clarity, wording and learner experience without changing the intended meaning.



• Export completed courses as tested **SCORM packages** suitable for LearnWorlds.



• Upload and test courses within LearnWorlds, including completion tracking, navigation, quiz results and mobile responsiveness.



• Provide all editable source files, graphics and final SCORM packages at the completion of each project.



• Respond to feedback and complete agreed revisions before final approval.



**Example Course Topics You’ll Work On:**



• Financial Foundations for Franchise Partners



• Reading Financial Reports for Franchise Partners



• Financial Compliance and Risk Management



• People Management and Employer Responsibilities



• Local Area Marketing and Business Growth



• Business Planning and Franchise Performance



**Skills & Qualifications:**



• Demonstrated experience in instructional design, eLearning development or online course creation.



• Strong experience using **Articulate Rise 360**. Articulate Storyline experience is highly desirable.



• Experience creating and testing SCORM-compliant courses.



• Experience working with LearnWorlds or a similar learning management system.



• Ability to turn detailed written content into visually engaging, practical and interactive learning.



• Strong graphic design skills and a good understanding of professional course layout and branding.



• Experience creating scenarios, quizzes, knowledge checks and other interactive learning activities.



• Basic video and audio editing capability.



• Excellent written English, proofreading skills and attention to detail.



• Ability to simplify complex information without removing important detail or changing its meaning.



• Ability to work independently, communicate clearly and meet agreed deadlines.



• Experience developing business, finance, franchising, leadership or professional development courses would be an advantage.



**Initial Paid Trial**



Three shortlisted candidates will each be invited to complete the same paid trial project: the development of one complete micro-course using content supplied by Franchise Education Australia.



The trial will assess:



• Instructional design and course structure



• Visual quality and brand alignment



• Creativity and appropriate use of interaction



• Accuracy and attention to detail



• Learner experience across desktop and mobile devices



• SCORM functionality and LearnWorlds compatibility



• Communication, responsiveness and ability to meet deadlines



The trial must include the completed course, final SCORM package and all editable source files.



**How to Apply**



Please include:



• A brief overview of relevant eLearning and instructional design experience.



• Examples of courses created using Articulate Rise 360 and/or Storyline.



• Details of experience creating SCORM packages and working with LearnWorlds or similar platforms.



• A clear description of the parts of the course-development process personally completed in the examples provided.



• Availability and typical turnaround time for a 15–20-minute online micro-course.



• Confirmation that all editable source files will be provided at project completion.

You MUST have hands-on experience managing Google Ads campaigns for real businesses.



Ideally, you have experience with:



Local service businesses

Lead generation campaigns

Beauty, aesthetic, wellness or similar businesses

Australian, UK, US or other English-speaking markets

What is working?

What is wasting money?

Why are we getting or not getting leads?

What should we change next?

Conversion tracking

Search Terms reports

Keyword and competitor research

Simply launches campaigns and checks them once a month

Remote position.

title: Luxury Travel Operations Coordinator (Remote)
description:
Position Overview



As a Luxury Travel Operations Coordinator, you will be responsible for managing time-sensitive VIP airport and travel services for passengers traveling through airports worldwide. The role involves coordinating complex travel arrangements, handling urgent operational requests, and ensuring flawless service delivery for high-profile and luxury travel clients.



This position carries significant operational responsibility. You will regularly handle urgent requests, last-minute travel changes, and multiple priorities simultaneously, often under strict deadlines. Success in this role requires exceptional attention to detail, strong organizational skills, sound judgment, and the ability to remain calm, focused, and responsive in a fast-paced environment where quick and accurate decision-making is critical.

- Respond promptly to all incoming calls,

- Access to a computer or laptop, reliable high-speed internet, and a working phone for calls.

- Ability to work flexible schedules, including early mornings, evenings, weekends, and public holidays.

- Professional, calm, and composed approach when handling high-pressure situations.

We're only looking for full-time, long-term, ongoing cooperation.



Work schedules available:

8 AM to 4 PM US EST

4 PM to 12 AM US EST



Your work week will be 5 days per week, with 2 days off per week. Days off will be selected with your manager. We will try to accommodate your preferences for which days you like, based on availability.



This role starts ASAP.



Job Duties and Responsibilities:

Receive incoming phone calls and live chats from potential customers (prospects) who indicated that they need shopping assistance. This does not include calls and chats from existing customers that need help with their orders (that’s a job for a different department)

Makes follow-up calls, writes follow-up
s, and text messages to potential buyers. We try to follow up 5x with each person who contacted us (unless they indicate that they are no longer interested). We don’t do cold calling. Only reaching out to prospects who interacted with our online store and left their contact information.

After each interaction with a prospect/customer, writes notes & comments in our CRM (Asana)

Communicate efficiently and build rapport with potential customers

Assists prospects in their shopping journey and helps make the purchase decision

Ensures that all prospects’ questions and objections are addressed

Leads every interaction to a close sale, which means an order is placed on our online store

Prepares custom quotes, price matches competitors if necessary, and offers custom discounts. This requires calculating margins & ensuring profitability.

Answering questions about the products we offer, including technical questions. Learns the specifications, features and benefits of our bestsellers. Over time, becomes an expert in the industry.

If not able to answer product-specific questions, conducts research in the materials provided by the supplier, or reaches out to the supplier to get the information

Confirms stock availability and lead times when offering products to prospects

Documents standard procedures and best practices in a written form, so that other tea ---------- mbers can learn from them



Requirements:

At least 2 years of experience in sales on the phone

Experience must include both inbound and outbound sales

Excellent written and verbal English communication skills

Experience in Customer Service on the phone is a nice to have

Experience in the e-commerce (online shopping) industry is nice to have

Home improvement, construction, and gas plumbing industry experience is a plus

Outgoing, friendly, and lively

Can-do mindset, with a sense of ownership, pride in your performance, and its impact on the company’s success

Long-term commitment - treat this as your career



What we can offer:

Sales commission: 12% of gross profit from all orders closed. Gross profit means the sale amount minus the product and shipping costs. Paid monthly. No upper limit. Monthly commission payouts range between $1,200 (the guaranteed minimum) and as high as $3,000 (for the top performer). The average monthly payout is $1,465 (average from the last 2 years).

$1,200/month minimum guaranteed pay

15 days paid days off per year (also convertible to min. guaranteed commission)

Paid training on all aspects of the role

Opportunities for professional development

Friendly atmosphere

Online Interview process

Fully remote position

Summary

Summary

We have a list of Australian B2B leads ready to go. Your job is to call them, find out whether they have a genuine problem AI or automation could solve, and book qualified leads into a free 30-minute discovery call with our consultant using a scheduling link, live on the phone.



This is a qualification role, not a chat role. We do not want appointments with people who were too polite to say no. We want appointments with business owners and managers who named a real problem and want to explore fixing it.



**What you'll do**



- Work through the lead list we provide, calling during Australian business hours (AEST/AEDT)

- Follow our call script and qualification checklist (provided, with training on your first day)

- Qualify each lead on three points before booking: a named pain point, genuine intent to act in the next month or two, and decision-maker involvement

- Book qualified leads directly into our scheduling link while on the call, with notes on their business and pain point

- Log every call outcome in the tracking sheet we provide (booked, nurture, callback, not interested, do not call, no answer)

- Give us a short summary at the end of each calling session: dials, conversations, bookings



**What we provide**



- The lead list (name, business, phone, and context where available)

- A tested call script with objection handling

- The scheduling link and tracking sheet

- A briefing call before you start, and feedback on your first recorded calls



**What counts as a qualified appointment (bonus criteria)**



An appointment earns the bonus when all of the following are true:



1. The lead named a specific business problem or process they want improved

2. The lead confirmed they want to explore solutions in the near term, not "someday"

3. The decision-maker is on the booking (or attending with the contact)

4. The lead attends the call (reschedules still count once attended; no-shows do not)



**PAY**



- Base rate: You hourly rate

- Calls may be recorded and reviewed for quality; consistent quality leads to more hours and a long-term arrangement



**Requirements**



- Fluent, clear spoken English; comfortable and natural on the phone with Australian business owners

title: Senior Java Developer (E-commerce)
description:
Summary:

We are seeking an accomplished Senior Java Developer to drive the development and optimization of our e-commerce platform. The ideal candidate will bring extensive experience in Java, microservices architecture, and performance tuning, along with the leadership skills to mentor a growing development team and steer complex projects to success.



Key Responsibilities

Application Design & Development



Architect, design, and develop high-performance, scalable Java-based e-commerce applications.

Implement microservices and event-driven architectures to ensure modular and resilient systems.

Performance Optimization & Scalability



Monitor, analyze, and optimize system performance, memory usage, and throughput.

Troubleshoot concurrency, threading, and performance bottlenecks using advanced profiling tools and techniques.

Technical Leadership



Mentor junior and mid-level developers, setting best practices in coding, testing, and deployment.

Drive architectural decisions and technology choices aligned with business needs and industry standards.

System Integration



Integrate third-party APIs, payment gateways, and services to enhance platform capabilities.

Implement caching solutions (e.g., Redis, Memcached) and messaging systems (e.g., RabbitMQ, Kafka) for efficient data handling.'



Quality Assurance & Testing



Champion test-driven development (TDD) and continuous integration/continuous delivery (CI/CD).

Write and maintain robust unit, integration, and end-to-end tests using frameworks such as JUnit, TestNG, and Mockito.

DevOps & Deployment



Collaborate with DevOps teams to automate builds, deployments, and monitoring (e.g., Jenkins, GitLab CI, Docker, Kubernetes).

Ensure high availability, fault tolerance, and seamless scalability in production environments.

Security & Compliance



Enforce secure coding practices, including data encryption, OAuth/JWT-based authentication, and compliance with PCI-DSS/GDPR where applicable.

Continuously monitor and mitigate security vulnerabilities and threats.

Documentation & Collaboration



Produce clear, comprehensive technical documentation and architectural diagrams.

Work cross-functionally with product managers, QA, UX designers, and other engineers to deliver robust solutions within agile sprints.



Continuous Improvement



Stay current with emerging trends, tools, and technologies to evolve and enhance our software development lifecycle.

Propose and implement improvements to optimize code quality, productivity, and operational efficiency.



Note: Please send a link to your updated CV, no uploaded CV will not be entertained.



Qualifications:



5+ years of professional Java development experience, ideally on large-scale e-commerce or SaaS platforms.

Demonstrated success in building and deploying microservices, distributed systems, and event-driven architectures.

Technical Expertise



Java Proficiency: Strong command of Java 8+ features (Streams, Lambdas), concurrency, memory management, and JVM internals.

Frameworks & Libraries: Advanced experience with Spring Boot, Spring Data, Spring Security, Hibernate/JPA.

API & Integrations: Experience creating RESTful APIs, integrating third-party services, and working with GraphQL (preferred).

Database Systems: Hands-on experience with MySQL, PostgreSQL, or MongoDB; adept at writing complex queries and optimizing database performance.

Messaging & Caching: Practical knowledge of message brokers (RabbitMQ, Kafka) and caching systems (Redis, Memcached).

Build & CI/CD: Proficiency in Maven/Gradle, Git, Jenkins/GitLab CI, Docker, and Kubernetes for seamless development and deployment.

Testing: Expertise in TDD, unit testing, integration testing, and test automation frameworks like JUnit, TestNG, and Mockito.

Performance Monitoring & Profiling: Familiarity with tools like VisualVM, YourKit, or New Relic for troubleshooting and tuning.

Soft Skills



Leadership: Demonstrated ability to mentor developers and influence technical direction.

Collaboration: Excellent communication skills, capable of working effectively with product owners, designers, and cross-functional teams.

Adaptability: Thrives in a fast-paced, agile environment, reacting quickly to changing requirements.

Problem-Solving: Proven analytical mindset and a pragmatic approach to solving complex challenges.

title: Quality Analyst - eCommerce
description:
We’re a fast-growing eCommerce company dedicated to delivering exceptional customer experiences across multiple marketplaces, including Amazon, eBay and our direct-to-consumer channels. As we scale, we’re looking for a seasoned Customer Service Manager who understands the intricacies of online retail, thrives in a dynamic environment, and has a proven track record of building and leading high-performing support teams.



Are you ready to solve problems with precision, and bring energy to a fast-moving eCommerce team? We are looking for a highly experienced Quality Analyst to join our growing support organization. 



As a Quality Analyst, you will serve as a subject matter expert responsible for evaluating operational processes, customer interactions, and service output to ensure compliance with internal standards. Guided by Kaizen principles, you will leverage your expertise to analyze performance data, perform deep-dive Root Cause Analysis (RCA), identify incremental improvement opportunities, and collaborate with team leads to drive actionable process refinements and coaching programs.



What You'll Do:



Quality Evaluations: Conduct regular, thorough audits of customer interactions (calls,
s, chats, or tickets) and operational outputs against defined quality frameworks.



Data & Trend Analysis: Analyze complex quality metrics, CSAT/NPS scores, and defect trends using data visualization to identify systemic issues and areas for continuous refinement.



Root Cause Analysis (RCA): Perform structured, expert-level Root Cause Analysis on quality gaps and errors to prevent recurrence and support sustainable process improvements.



Calibration & Consistency: Facilitate and lead weekly/monthly calibration sessions with team leaders and managers to ensure standard evaluation practices across the board.



Data Storytelling: Translate raw quality metrics into compelling data stories and high-impact insights for executive stakeholders and team leaders.



Kaizen & Continuous Improvement: Partner with operations and training teams to drive Kaizen initiatives, updating standard operating procedures (SOPs), knowledge base articles, and onboarding materials.



Feedback & Coaching Support: Provide actionable RCA-backed feedback and mentorship to team leads and trainers to assist in targeted coaching interventions.



Qualifications & Requirements

• Experience: 3+ years of direct experience as a proven Quality Analyst, QA Specialist, or related operational auditor within a fast-paced environment.

• Pro-Level Expertise: Demonstrated track record of mastering QA workflows, driving measurable quality wins, and operating independently with minimal oversight.

• Analytical Skills & RCA: Advanced ability to conduct Root Cause Analysis, interpret complex operational datasets, and uncover hidden performance trends.

• Data Visualization & Storytelling: Proven capability to visually present complex data clearly and articulate high-impact findings through engaging data storytelling.

• Communication: Exceptional written and verbal communication skills; highly comfortable presenting strategic insights and recommendations to team leads and senior leadership.

• Tool Proficiency: Mastery of QA tools/software, CRM platforms (e.g., Salesforce, Zendesk), and spreadsheet software (e.g., Excel, Google Sheets).

• Attention to Detail: Meticulous accuracy, strict objectivity, and sharp critical thinking when evaluating complex workflows.

• Education: Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Communications, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).



Nice to Have

• Lean Six Sigma Yellow Belt certification preferred, but not required.

• Practical experience leading Kaizen continuous improvement projects or workshops in a service/operations setting.

•  Proven track record of developing QA scorecard rubrics and evaluation frameworks from scratch.



What We Offer:

• A collaborative, growth-oriented culture.

• Competitive salary and performance-based incentives.

• HMO package



Note: Please send a link to your updated CV, failure to comply will not move forward with the interview.

Ready to lead with impact? Apply now and help us shape the future of customer experience. We’re excited to meet leaders who care deeply about people, process, and performance.

title: Marketplace Outreach Assistant
description:
Hey! Real human here, not a faceless agency.



I run a small, growing business in the car world. We find people selling their cars privately, have a friendly chat with them, and connect them to buyers who want those cars. Think of it as matchmaking for used vehicles. Nobody gets scammed, everybody wins, and it's honestly kind of fun once you get the hang of it.



I need someone to be my right hand on the messaging side. This is the engine of the whole business, and right now I'm the engine, which means I never get to sleep. That's where you come in.



What you'll actually do:



Message people selling cars on
 Marketplace. Friendly opener, a couple of easy questions (is it still available, any a
, how are the tires and brakes, are they open to offers).

Keep conversations going and be quick to reply. Speed matters here.

As you get the hang of it: help spot good cars, gather the details, and pass the hot ones over to me.



Who I'm looking for:



You write English like a real North American texting a friend. Casual, warm, a little personality. NOT stiff, NOT formal, NOT "Dear valued seller, I hope this message finds you well." If you just cringed at that sentence, we're going to get along.

You're reliable and you actually reply fast. If you disappear for six hours, this isn't the gig.

You follow instructions exactly, even the boring ones. Especially the boring ones.

Bonus points if you'
 used
 Marketplace before, but I'll teach you everything.



The deal:



Full-time, long-term. I'm looking for someone to grow with, not a one-week fling.

$500/MONTH(CAD) to start, paid weekly. Raises come fast once you prove you're solid. I'd rather pay a great person more than babysit a cheap one. Commission structure will be brought in quickly. If you help sell more, you make more!

I'll train you properly. For the first bit I'll review your work daily, not to breathe down your neck, but because the messaging is an art and I want you to be great at it. Nail it, and you earn more freedom and more money.



To apply, read carefully, this is the test:

Start your message with the word "MUSTANG" so I know you actually read this.

Then tell me:



One sentence about yourself the way you'd text a friend, and why you'd be a good fit.

The short version of your long-term plans and goals.

Tell me about the last thing that made you laugh.



That's it. No résumé wall, no life story. If you follow these few steps, you're already ahead of 80% of applicants. If you don't, I'll never see your message, so don't skip 'em.



Talk soon,

Jason

title: Creative Strategist / Video Editor (BOF Ads Specialist)
description:
Hey there,



We are a fast-paced marketing company and we are looking for a hybrid Creative Strategist and Video Editor to create high-converting Bottom-of-Funnel (BOF) ads for our clients. If you have a strategic marketing brain, are a high-level video editor, and know how to translate direct response psychology into ads that make people click and buy, we will be hiring a full-time editor and they will be eligible for performance-based bonuses and a great long-term career.



What are we looking for?



1. A Video Editing Expert highly proficient in Premiere Pro, CapCut, After Effects, or DaVinci Resolve.

2. A Direct Response Thinker who understands Meta ads / Paid ads (urgency, offers, social proof). Strong writing skills are a huge plus!

3. Highly intelligent and resourceful—able to figure out complex transitions or text effects you see in the wild without needing a tutorial.

4. Reliable, fluent in English (for flawless text-on-screen and ad copy), and possessing a machine powerful enough to render video seamlessly.



How will this job work?



1. You will comb through the Meta and TikTok Ad Libraries to hunt down high-performing BOF ads in our clients' niches.

2. You will analyze why the original ad worked (the hook, text-on-screen, transitions) and reverse-engineer its success. Then rewrite it for our clients using AI.

3. Get into the editing timeline! Recreate these winning concepts for our clients by mastering pacing, pattern interrupts, and strong CTAs.

4. Recreate winning BOF static images and copy using our existing AI prompts. GET CREATIVE!

These videos are Bottom-of-Funnel (BOF) ads and serve as our core direct-response creatives. Unlike just making a "pretty" video, it’s very important to edit specifically for conversion, apply direct response principles, and drive the viewer to make a purchase right now.



How to Apply (Read Carefully)



Applications without a google link of this project will not be considered.



To see your skills in action, we have a short test task. We want to see how you think strategically and how you execute in the editing room.



The Scenario (Our "Dummy" Client): You are working with our client, Apex Hydration, a premium electrolyte powder brand. Their target audience is 25-45-year-old fitness enthusiasts and busy professionals. Their unique selling points (USPs) are: zero sugar, 3x the electrolytes of sports drinks, and an energy boost without the crash. They are currently running a Bottom-of-Funnel (BOF) offer: Buy 2 boxes, get 2 free.



Your Mission:

Step 1: The Hunt Go to the Meta or TikTok Ad Library and find a highly effective BOF video ad from a competitor in the same space (e.g., Liquid IV, LMNT, Waterboy, or a similar D2C brand).



We are looking for an ad that clearly utilizes direct response principles (urgency, social proof, offer, strong CTA, text-on-screen).



Step 2: The Recreation Using the ad you found as a blueprint, recreate the video for Apex Hydration.

Assets: Since you don't have our client's actual assets, please use free stock footage (Pexels, Mixkit, etc.), images, or AI-generated visuals to represent the product.



Editing: We are judging your pacing, use of text-on-screen, transitions, and how well you adapt the competitor's winning formula to our dummy client's specific offer.



Keep the video under 30 seconds.



Step 3: Submit your Application 

1. A link to (or screen recording of) the original competitor ad you chose.

2. Your final edited .mp4 video for Apex Hydration.

3. Your Resume

4. A link to your Video Editing Reel/Portfolio 



Send the
 to 
 with the Subject Line: BOF Creative Strategist Application - [Your Name]



We aren't looking for Hollywood perfection with stock footage; we are looking at your timing, your ability to rewrite the script, your understanding of BOF structure, and your overall editing rhythm.



Good luck!
